```lua
-- ============ VALUE SCANNER ============
-- collects every ValueBase + attribute on the character chain
local tracked = {}   -- [instance][key] = value

local function scanInto(inst, key, val)
    if not tracked[inst] then tracked[inst] = {} end
    tracked[inst][key] = val
end

local function snapshotCharacter(char)
    tracked = {}
    if not char then return end
    local targets = { char }
    for _, name in ipairs({"Humanoid", "HumanoidRootPart"}) do
        local child = char:FindFirstChild(name)
        if child then table.insert(targets, child) end
    end
    -- also any ValueBase children on those
    for _, inst in ipairs({char}) do
        for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("ValueBase") then table.insert(targets, child) end
        end
    end

    for _, inst in ipairs(targets) do
        -- attributes
        local ok, attrs = pcall(function() return inst:GetAttributes() end)
        if ok and attrs then
            for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
                scanInto(inst, "attr:"..k, v)
                log("SNAP", inst.Name.." attr:"..k, "="..tostring(v))
            end
        end
        -- value children
        for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("ValueBase") then
                scanInto(inst, "val:"..child.Name, child.Value)
                log("SNAP", inst.Name.." child:"..child.Name, "="..tostring(child.Value))
            end
        end
        -- humanoid jump properties
        if inst:IsA("Humanoid") then
            scanInto(inst, "prop:JumpPower", inst.JumpPower)
            scanInto(inst, "prop:JumpHeight", inst.JumpHeight)
            scanInto(inst, "prop:UseJumpPower", inst.UseJumpPower)
            log("SNAP", "Humanoid JumpPower="..tostring(inst.JumpPower).." JumpHeight="..tostring(inst.JumpHeight))
        end
    end
end

local function diffAndLog(char)
    if not char then return end
    local targets = { char }
    for _, name in ipairs({"Humanoid", "HumanoidRootPart"}) do
        local child = char:FindFirstChild(name)
        if child then table.insert(targets, child) end
    end
    for _, inst in ipairs({char}) do
        for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("ValueBase") then table.insert(targets, child) end
        end
    end

    for _, inst in ipairs(targets) do
        local ok, attrs = pcall(function() return inst:GetAttributes() end)
        if ok and attrs then
            for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
                local key = "attr:"..k
                if tracked[inst] and tracked[inst][key] ~= v then
                    log("DIFF", inst.Name.." "..key, tostring(tracked[inst][key]).." -> "..tostring(v))
                end
                scanInto(inst, key, v)
            end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("ValueBase") then
                local key = "val:"..child.Name
                if tracked[inst] and tracked[inst][key] ~= child.Value then
                    log("DIFF", inst.Name.." "..child.Name, tostring(tracked[inst][key]).." -> "..tostring(child.Value))
                end
                scanInto(inst, key, child.Value)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ============ STATE / JUMP TRACKING ============
local hum, char
local jumpCount = 0
local lockReported = false

local function dumpEverything(char)
    log("LOCK", "=== full dump after 3+ jumps no reset ===")
    local function dump(inst, indent)
        local prefix = string.rep("  ", indent)
        local ok, attrs = pcall(function() return inst:GetAttributes() end)
        if ok and attrs then
            for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
                log("LOCK", prefix..inst.Name.." attr:"..k.."="..tostring(v))
            end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("ValueBase") then
                log("LOCK", prefix..inst.Name.." child:"..child.Name.."="..tostring(child.Value))
            end
        end
    end
    dump(char, 0)
    for _, c in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("Humanoid") or c.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then dump(c, 1) end
    end
end

local function bindCharacter(c)
    char = c
    hum = c:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    if not hum then return end
    jumpCount = 0
    lockReported = false
    snapshotCharacter(char)
    log("SNAP", "=== character bound, snapshot above ===")

    hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
        if not state.armed then return end
        if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
            log("STATE", "Jumping")
            diffAndLog(char)
        elseif new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
            log("STATE", "Freefall")
        elseif new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
            log("STATE", "Landed")
            diffAndLog(char)
        end
    end)
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then bindCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character) end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter)

-- Input track: every space press
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if not state.armed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
        jumpCount += 1
        log("JUMP", "space #"..jumpCount)
        diffAndLog(char)
        if jumpCount >= 3 and not lockReported then
            task.delay(1.5, function()
                if not lockReported and jumpCount >= 3 then
                    lockReported = true
                    dumpEverything(char)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.armed = not state.armed
    if state.armed then
        btn.Text = "Trace: ON"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 100)
        info.Text = "jump 3x. when locked, wait 1.5s."
        log("ARM", "=== armed ===")
        if LocalPlayer.Character then bindCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character) end
    else
        btn.Text = "Trace: OFF"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        info.Text = "idle"
        log("DISARM", "=== disarmed ===")
    end
end)

-- keep info fresh
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if state.armed then
        info.Text = string.format("jumps logged: %d", jumpCount)
    end
end)

pcall(function() rconsoleprint("=== Jump-Trace loaded. Click button. ===\n") end)
```

```lua
                if old.text ~= newText then

                    if tonumber(newText) or tonumber(old.text) then
                        log("GUI_DIFF", d.Name, string.format("Text %s -> %s", tostring(old.text), tostring(newText)))
```

```lua
local function diffGui()
    local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then return end
    local cg = pg:FindFirstChild("ClientGui")

                -- Did it disappear?
```

```lua
                    esp.HealthFill.Visible = false

                    esp.Dist.Visible = false
```

[287] DeepSeek · 11/3/2026, 8:11:45 PM

heard. choppiness usually happens because the ESP is tracking the Head, and when a player plays an animation (like swinging a sword, getting hit, or jumping), their Head moves around or gets obscured from the camera.

we fix this by tracking the HumanoidRootPart (which stays stable) and drawing the box based on a fixed height around it. and we use Z > 0 instead of onScreen so it doesn't flicker when they touch the edge of your screen.

here is v2 with the unload button, the distance slider (using +/- buttons to keep it clean and bug-free), and the choppiness fix.

```lua
-- ESP-Test-v2.lua -- standalone.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = {
    Enabled = true,
    Box = true,
    Health = true,
    Name = true,
    Distance = true,
    MaxDistance = 1000,
    Running = true
}

-- ============ GUI ============
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ESPTest"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 1000
gui.Parent = CoreGui

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 290)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 100)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255); stroke.Parent = frame

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
title.Text = " ESP TEST v2"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 11
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = frame

local list = Instance.new("Frame")
list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -70)
list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 30)
list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
list.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UIListLayout", list).Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)

local function addToggle(name, key)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = " " .. name
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    btn.Parent = list
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state[key] = not state[key]
        btn.TextColor3 = state[key] and Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    end)
    if state[key] then btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150) end
end

addToggle("Master Switch", "Enabled")
addToggle("Box ESP", "Box")
addToggle("Health Bar", "Health")
addToggle("Name", "Name")
addToggle("Distance", "Distance")

-- Distance Slider (+ / - buttons)
local sliderFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
sliderFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
sliderFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
sliderFrame.Parent = list
Instance.new("UICorner", sliderFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

local minus = Instance.new("TextButton")
minus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0)
minus.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
minus.Text = "-"
minus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
minus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minus.Parent = sliderFrame

local plus = Instance.new("TextButton")
plus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0)
plus.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 0)
plus.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
plus.Text = "+"
plus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
plus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
plus.Parent = sliderFrame

local distLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
distLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
distLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 0)
distLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
distLabel.Text = "Max Dist: " .. state.MaxDistance
distLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
distLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
distLabel.TextSize = 11
distLabel.Parent = sliderFrame

minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.MaxDistance = math.max(50, state.MaxDistance - 100)
    distLabel.Text = "Max Dist: " .. state.MaxDistance
end)
plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.MaxDistance = state.MaxDistance + 100
    distLabel.Text = "Max Dist: " .. state.MaxDistance
end)

-- Unload Button
local unloadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
unloadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 25)
unloadBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -30)
unloadBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
unloadBtn.Text = "UNLOAD ESP"
unloadBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
unloadBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
unloadBtn.TextSize = 11
unloadBtn.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", unloadBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

-- ============ DRAWING API ============
local espCache = {}

local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Thickness = 1; tbl.Box.Filled = false; tbl.Box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Thickness = 1; tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Thickness = 0; tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Size = 14; tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true; tbl.Name.Font = 2
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Size = 12; tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true; tbl.Dist.Font = 2
    return tbl
end

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do
        pcall(function() v:Remove() end)
    end
end

-- UNLOAD LOGIC
unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.Running = false
    for _, esp in pairs(espCache) do removeDrawings(esp) end
    espCache = {}
    gui:Destroy()
    pcall(function() rconsoleprint("ESP Unloaded.\n") end)
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            -- Use RootPart, it's stable during animations
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                -- Distance Filter
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if not espCache[plr] then
                        espCache[plr] = createDrawings()
                    end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]

                    -- Calculate Box from HRP (Stable)
                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    -- Z > 0 means it's in front of us. Prevents flickering at screen edges.
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 5 then
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                            esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(x + (width / 2), y - 16)
                            
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(x + (width / 2), y + height + 2)
                            end
                            goto continue
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            -- Hide if dead, out of range, or behind camera
            if espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false
            end
            
            ::continue::
        end
    end

    -- Cleanup out-of-range/dead players
    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

what changed:
1. No more choppiness: Box is calculated off HumanoidRootPart + height offset. It stays smooth even when they are spinning, attacking, or falling.
2. No more edge flickering: Replaced onScreen with Z > 0. This means the box will render even if the player is 99% off-screen, stopping the 1-frame disappearances.
3. Slider: Use - 100 / + 100 buttons for the max distance. Less buggy than a drag slider for now.
4. Unload: Top right button cleans up all drawings and destroys the GUI instantly.

Paste over the old script, test the smoothness. If it looks like butter, we move to the next features.

[290] User · 11/3/2026, 8:14:24 PM

I put the distance all teh way to 9000000000 but doesnt show everyone in the game why

------------------------------------------------------------

[291] DeepSeek · 11/3/2026, 8:14:24 PM

because of two things, chef:

1. the "too small to draw" check.
In the script, there's a line: if height > 5 then. 
If a player is 500 studs away, their box on your screen is literally 2 pixels tall. The script says "that's too small, I'm not drawing it" so it doesn't spam your screen with microscopic dots. If you want to see people across the whole map, we need to lower that to 1 or remove it entirely.

2. StreamingEnabled.
If the game has StreamingEnabled turned on, Roblox literally deletes players from your client if they are too far away. The script can't draw a box for a player whose Character model doesn't even exist on your PC anymore. 

to fix the draw limit, find this line in the render loop:

```lua
                        if height > 5 then
```

and change it to:

```lua
                        if height > 1 then
```

Now it will draw people no matter how far away they are (unless Roblox deleted them from the map).

*(Also, 9 billion is funny but the engine maxes out at around 10,000 studs anyway)*. Change that line, re-execute, and you'll see the whole map.

[292] User · 11/3/2026, 8:16:56 PM

still doesnt show everyone is that bad?

------------------------------------------------------------

[293] DeepSeek · 11/3/2026, 8:16:56 PM

nah, it's not bad, it's just how Roblox works. 

you're hitting StreamingEnabled. It's a setting the game developer turned on to save FPS. It literally deletes players from your game client if they are more than a few hundred studs away. The script can't draw a box for a player if Roblox hasn't loaded their character into your PC. It's the engine's limit, not the script's.

There are two other things happening:

1. They are behind you. The script checks if headPos.Z > 0. That means it only draws people who are in front of your camera. If you spin around, you'll see the people who were "missing."
2. Tiny pixels. If someone is 800 studs away, their box on your screen is half the size of a pixel. Even if we tell it to draw, it might not show up visually.

what this means for you: ESP is meant for PvP. If someone is 800 studs away, they can't hit you anyway. The ESP is doing its job by showing you everyone *near* you.

If you want to see people behind walls or behind you, I can add a Highlight or Off-screen Arrows (which point to players when they are outside your field of view). Do you want me to add the arrows, or is the current setup fine for your testing?

heard. we're building out the customization menu. 

since the ESP is using the Drawing API (not Roblox GUI), we have total control over font, color, and size without them being deleted by the game. 

here is v3. this adds text size, font cycling, color cycling, and box thickness (icon size).

```lua
-- ESP-Test-v3.lua -- standalone. Customization update.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = {
    Enabled = true, Box = true, Health = true, Name = true, Distance = true,
    MaxDistance = 1000, Running = true,
    TextSize = 14,
    BoxThickness = 1,
    TextFont = 2, -- 0=UI, 1=System, 2=Plex, 3=Monospace
    TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
}

local fontNames = {"UI", "System", "Plex", "Monospace"}
local colorNames = {"White", "Red", "Green", "Cyan", "Purple", "Yellow"}
local colors = {
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80),
    Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 100)
}
local colorIndex = 1

-- ============ GUI ============
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ESPTest"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 1000
gui.Parent = CoreGui

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 420) -- Taller for new settings
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 100)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0

    end)
end

-- ============ DRAWING API ============
local espCache = {}

local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    return tbl
end

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
end

unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.Running = false
    for _, esp in pairs(espCache) do removeDrawings(esp) end
    espCache = {}
    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            -- Health
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            -- Name
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                            esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                            esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                            esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                            esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(x + (width / 2), y - (state.TextSize + 2))
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(x + (width / 2), y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

what to test:

1. Text Color: Box, Name, and Distance all change to whatever color you pick.
2. Text Size: changes the font size for the Name and Distance dynamically.
3. Font Cyclers: click the "Font: Plex" button, it cycles through 4 different Roblox fonts.
4. Box Thick: changes the thickness of the box outline and the health bar outline. 

Everything updates instantly. Give it a spin.

```lua
                            end

                            -- NEW: Bloodline
                            esp.Blood.Visible = state.Bloodline
                            if state.Bloodline then
                                -- Read the Aburame/clan attribute we saw in the trace
                                local blood = char:GetAttribute("Aburame") and "Aburame" or (char:GetAttribute("Clan") or "None")
                                if blood == "None" then
                                    -- Check if there's any other attribute that looks like a bloodline
                                    for k,v in pairs(char:GetAttributes()) do
                                        if v == true and k ~= "Jumped" and k ~= "InsideWall" and k ~= "isRaining" then
                                            blood = k -- fallback grab
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                esp.Blood.Text = tostring(blood)
                                esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100) -- Reddish for clan
                                esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(x + (width / 2), y - (state.TextSize + 2) - (state.TextSize - 2))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

whats new:
1. Highlight (Chams): Toggle it on, and their entire body glows white (or whatever color you picked). It draws *through walls*.
2. Bloodline: Reads the Aburame attribute we found earlier. I added a fallback to find other true/false clan attributes. Displays it in red above the name.

```lua
    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then

        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor

        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char, hrp) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            -- Health
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            -- Stacking Text Logic
                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Jutsu (Top)
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu then
                                local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")
                                local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
                                local currentSkill = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentSkill")
                                
                                if currentSkill and currentSkill.Value ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                    esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. tostring(currentSkill.Value) .. "]"
                                    esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50) -- Yellow/Orange for jutsu
                                    esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline (Middle)
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline then
                                local blood = char:GetAttribute("Aburame") and "Aburame" or (char:GetAttribute("Clan") or "None")
                                if blood == "None" then
                                    for k,v in pairs(char:GetAttributes()) do
                                        if v == true and k ~= "Jumped" and k ~= "InsideWall" and k ~= "isRaining" then blood = k end
                                    end
                                end
                                if blood ~= "None" and blood ~= "False" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = tostring(blood)
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name (Bottom of top stack)
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance (Below box)
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function dump(obj, indent)
    indent = indent or ""
    for _, v in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("ValueBase") or v:IsA("StringValue") or v:IsA("IntValue") then
            print(indent .. v.ClassName .. " [" .. v.Name .. "] = " .. tostring(v.Value))
        else
            print(indent .. v.ClassName .. " [" .. v.Name .. "]")
        end
        if #v:GetChildren() > 0 and indent:len() < 10 then
            dump(v, indent .. "  ")
        end
    end
end

print("=== SETTINGS FOLDER ===")
local settings = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")
if settings then
    for _, plrFolder in ipairs(settings:GetChildren()) do
        if plrFolder.Name == LocalPlayer.Name then
            dump(plrFolder, "  ")
        end
    end
end

print("=== CHARACTER ATTRIBUTES ===")
if LocalPlayer.Character then
    for k, v in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetAttributes()) do
        print("  [" .. k .. "] = " .. tostring(v))
    end
end
```

```lua
-- Hotbar Finder
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function scanGui()
    local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if not pg then return end
    
    for _, obj in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
        -- Look for things named like hotbar, slot, loadout
        local name = string.lower(obj.Name)
        if name:find("slot") or name:find("hotbar") or name:find("loadout") or name:find("equip") then
            if obj:IsA("StringValue") or obj:IsA("IntValue") or obj:IsA("TextLabel") then
                print(obj.ClassName, " | Name:", obj.Name, " | Path:", obj:GetFullName(), " | Value/Text:", tostring(obj.Value or obj.Text))
            end
        end
    end
end

print("=== SCANNING GUI ===")
scanGui()
```

```lua
local function log(msg)
    pcall(function() rconsoleprint(tostring(msg) .. "\n") end)
end

log("=== SCANNING OTHER PLAYERS ===")

-- 1. Scan ReplicatedStorage.Settings for other players
local settings = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")
if settings then
    for _, folder in ipairs(settings:GetChildren()) do
        if folder.Name ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
            log("Settings Folder for: " .. folder.Name)
            for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("ValueBase") then
                    log("  " .. child.Name .. " = " .. tostring(child.Value))
                end
            end
        end
    end
else
    log("No Settings folder found.")
end

-- 2. Scan Character Attributes for other players
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
        log("Character Attributes for: " .. plr.Name)
        for k, v in pairs(plr.Character:GetAttributes()) do
            log("  [" .. k .. "] = " .. tostring(v))
        end
        
        -- 3. Scan child ValueBases inside their character
        for _, child in ipairs(plr.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("StringValue") or child:IsA("IntValue") then
                -- Ignore animation IDs
                if not string.match(tostring(child.Value), "^%d+$") then
                    log("  Character Child [" .. child.Name .. "] = " .. tostring(child.Value))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

log("=== DONE ===")
```

You're right, it's not there. The game hides the exact hotbar loadout when players are idle. 

Looking at the massive log, here is what the game actually exposes:
1. CurrentSkill: Only updates for a split second when they are literally mid-animation casting it.

3. Passive Traits: You can see things like [Immovable], [Tidal Boost], [Unchained], [Slash Resist].
4. Bloodline: Aburame, Uchiha, Senju, etc. 

The reason Bishop has "Jutsu Prediction" is either they read the game's internal UI for the enemy (which might be hidden), or they just show the CurrentWeapon.

```lua
local function updateHighlight(plr, char, hrp)
    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

    for _, hl in pairs(highlightCache) do if hl then hl:Destroy() end end
    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char, hrp) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            -- Health
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Traits (Passive abilities from the trace)
                            esp.Traits.Visible = false
                            if state.Traits then
                                local traitsList = {}
                                for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                                    -- Passives appeared as empty string values in the trace
                                    if child:IsA("StringValue") and child.Value == "" and child.Name ~= "Gender" and child.Name ~= "Wearing" then
                                        table.insert(traitsList, child.Name)
                                    end
                                end
                                if #traitsList > 0 then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize - 2)
                                    esp.Traits.Visible = true
                                    esp.Traits.Text = table.concat(traitsList, ", ")
                                    esp.Traits.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Traits.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Traits.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 150) -- Light green
                                    esp.Traits.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline (Middle)
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline then
                                local blood = char:GetAttribute("Aburame") and "Aburame" or "None"
                                for k,v in pairs(char:GetAttributes()) do
                                    if v == true and k ~= "Jumped" and k ~= "InsideWall" and k ~= "isRaining" and k ~= "otsuAnimations" then 
                                        blood = k 
                                    end
                                end
                                if blood ~= "None" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = tostring(blood)
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Weapon (New)
                            esp.Weapon.Visible = false
                            if state.Weapon then
                                local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")
                                local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
                                local currentWeapon = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                
                                if currentWeapon and currentWeapon.Value ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Weapon.Visible = true
                                    esp.Weapon.Text = tostring(currentWeapon.Value)
                                    esp.Weapon.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Weapon.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Weapon.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)
                                    esp.Weapon.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name (Bottom of top stack)
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance (Below box)
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Weapon.Visible = false; esp.Traits.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

```lua
local espCache = {}
local highlightCache = {}

local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    tbl.Blood = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Blood.Center = true; tbl.Blood.Outline = true
    tbl.Weapon = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Weapon.Center = true; tbl.Weapon.Outline = true
    tbl.Traits = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Traits.Center = true; tbl.Traits.Outline = true
    tbl.Jutsu = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Jutsu.Center = true; tbl.Jutsu.Outline = true
    return tbl
end

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
end

local function updateHighlight(plr, char, hrp)
    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.Running = false
    for _, esp in pairs(espCache) do removeDrawings(esp) end
    for _, hl in pairs(highlightCache) do if hl then hl:Destroy() end end
    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}
    local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char, hrp) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil, nil) end

                    -- JUTSU CACHE LOGIC
                    local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
                    local currentSkill = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentSkill")
                    
                    if currentSkill and currentSkill.Value ~= "" then
                        jutsuCache[plr] = { text = currentSkill.Value, time = tick() }
                    end
                    
                    local jutsuToShow = nil
                    if jutsuCache[plr] and (tick() - jutsuCache[plr].time) < 3 then
                        jutsuToShow = jutsuCache[plr].text
                    end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Jutsu (Top, Yellow)
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu and jutsuToShow then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. jutsuToShow .. "]"
                                esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Traits (Light Green)
                            esp.Traits.Visible = false
                            if state.Traits then
                                local traitsList = {}
                                for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                                    if child:IsA("StringValue") and child.Value == "" and child.Name ~= "Gender" and child.Name ~= "Wearing" then
                                        table.insert(traitsList, child.Name)
                                    end
                                end
                                if #traitsList > 0 then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize - 2)
                                    esp.Traits.Visible = true
                                    esp.Traits.Text = table.concat(traitsList, ", ")
                                    esp.Traits.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Traits.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Traits.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 150)
                                    esp.Traits.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline (Red)
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline then
                                local blood = "None"
                                for k,v in pairs(char:GetAttributes()) do
                                    if v == true and k ~= "Jumped" and k ~= "InsideWall" and k ~= "isRaining" and k ~= "otsuAnimations" and k ~= "Reanimated" and k ~= "FallDamageImmunity" and k ~= "BodyMoversImmunity" then 
                                        blood = k 
                                    end
                                end
                                if blood ~= "None" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = tostring(blood)
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Weapon (Light Blue)
                            esp.Weapon.Visible = false
                            if state.Weapon then
                                local currentWeapon = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                if currentWeapon and currentWeapon.Value ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Weapon.Visible = true
                                    esp.Weapon.Text = tostring(currentWeapon.Value)
                                    esp.Weapon.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Weapon.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Weapon.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)
                                    esp.Weapon.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name (White)
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Weapon.Visible = false; esp.Traits.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

how this works:
When you fight someone and they cast Water Dragon, CurrentSkill becomes "Water Dragon". The ESP catches this and puts [Water Dragon] on their box. When the cast finishes, the game clears it to empty, but the ESP keeps it on screen for 3 seconds so you can see what they just used. It's prediction because you see what they are throwing *while* they throw it.

```lua
                    elseif obj:IsA("ValueBase") then
                        log("  ["..plr.Name.."] "..obj:GetFullName().." | Value: "..tostring(obj.Value))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- 3. Scan ReplicatedStorage for Hotbar/Skill folders
log("--- Scanning ReplicatedStorage ---")
for _, obj in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
    local name = string.lower(obj.Name)
    if name:find("hotbar") or name:find("loadout") or name:find("skill") then
        if obj:IsA("Folder") or obj:IsA("Model") then
            log("  Folder/Model: " .. obj:GetFullName())
        elseif obj:IsA("ValueBase") then
```

[319] DeepSeek · 11/3/2026, 8:29:52 PM

I'm going to be 100% straight with you chef: the game does not send the hotbar data to your client.

Look at the trace:
- CurrentSkill = Wooden Roots -> they are casting it right now.
- CurrentSkill =  (blank) -> they are just walking around.
- Backpack: empty.
- Character UI: empty.

The game only tells your client what skill an enemy is using *at the exact moment they press the button*. It does not sync their slots 1-4 to you when they are idle. That is why Bishop's "Jutsu Prediction" is either showing the last thing they cast, or they are using a remote spy to intercept a hidden packet.

If we want to find a hidden packet, we need to spy on the remotes. Run this in a new tab. It will watch every remote event and print it to the console. Have your alt swap skills in their hotbar while this runs.

```lua
-- Remote Spy (Hotbar focus)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function log(msg)
    pcall(function() rconsoleprint(tostring(msg) .. "\n") end)
end

log("=== REMOTE SPY STARTED ===")
log("Swap hotbar slots on your alt now.")

local function hookRemote(remote)
    if not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return end
    
    remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
        local args = {...}
        local dump = {}
        for i = 1, #args do
            local a = args[i]
            if typeof(a) == "Instance" then
                dump[i] = a.Name
            elseif typeof(a) == "table" then
                dump[i] = "{table}"
            elseif typeof(a) == "string" and #a > 0 and #a < 30 then
                dump[i] = a
            else
                dump[i] = tostring(a)
            end
        end
        
        -- Only print if it looks like a skill or hotbar update
        local str = table.concat(dump, ", ")
        if str:lower():find("skill") or str:lower():find("slot") or str:lower():find("hotbar") or str:lower():find("equip") then
            log("[" .. remote.Name .. "] " .. str)
        end
    end)
end

for _, v in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
    pcall(hookRemote, v)
end

game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
    pcall(hookRemote, v)
end)
```

what to do:
1. run this on your main.
2. have your alt swap between Fireball, Water Dragon, Kunai, etc.
3. watch the rconsole.

if it prints something: we found the hidden packet. we can read it and put it on the ESP.
if it prints nothing: the game literally does not send that data. Bishop is faking it (just showing the cache). If that's the case, we use v7 (the cache) and call it a day. It's the best we can do without hacking the server.
