```lua
local espCache = {}
local highlightCache = {}

local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    tbl.Blood = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Blood.Center = true; tbl.Blood.Outline = true
    tbl.Weapon = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Weapon.Center = true; tbl.Weapon.Outline = true
    tbl.Traits = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Traits.Center = true; tbl.Traits.Outline = true
    tbl.Jutsu = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Jutsu.Center = true; tbl.Jutsu.Outline = true
    return tbl
end

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
end

local function updateHighlight(plr, char, hrp)
    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.Running = false
    for _, esp in pairs(espCache) do removeDrawings(esp) end
    for _, hl in pairs(highlightCache) do if hl then hl:Destroy() end end
    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}
    local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char, hrp) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- REAL JUTSU PREDICTION (From Sharingan Trace)
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local skillGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
                                local skillName = skillGui and skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
                                
                                if skillName and skillName:IsA("TextLabel") and skillName.Text ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                    esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. skillName.Text .. "]"
                                    esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end
                            
                            -- Traits
                            esp.Traits.Visible = false
                            if state.Traits then
                                local traitsList = {}
                                for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                                    if child:IsA("StringValue") and child.Value == "" and child.Name ~= "Gender" and child.Name ~= "Wearing" then
                                        table.insert(traitsList, child.Name)
                                    end
                                end
                                if #traitsList > 0 then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize - 2)
                                    esp.Traits.Visible = true
                                    esp.Traits.Text = table.concat(traitsList, ", ")
                                    esp.Traits.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Traits.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Traits.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 150)
                                    esp.Traits.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline then
                                local blood = "None"
                                for k,v in pairs(char:GetAttributes()) do
                                    if v == true and k ~= "Jumped" and k ~= "InsideWall" and k ~= "isRaining" and k ~= "otsuAnimations" and k ~= "Reanimated" and k ~= "FallDamageImmunity" and k ~= "BodyMoversImmunity" then 
                                        blood = k 
                                    end
                                end
                                if blood ~= "None" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = tostring(blood)
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Weapon
                            esp.Weapon.Visible = false
                            if state.Weapon then
                                local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
                                local currentWeapon = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                if currentWeapon and currentWeapon.Value ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Weapon.Visible = true
                                    esp.Weapon.Text = tostring(currentWeapon.Value)
                                    esp.Weapon.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Weapon.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Weapon.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)
                                    esp.Weapon.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Weapon.Visible = false; esp.Traits.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

Run this trace on your main (with Sharingan active), and look at someone with different skills equipped. This dumps every single GUI and TextLabel attached to other players, bypassing the weapon filter.

```lua
-- Sharingan Deep GUI Trace
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function log(msg)
    pcall(function() rconsoleprint(tostring(msg) .. "\n") end)
end

log("=== SHARINGAN DEEP GUI TRACE ===")
log("Turn on Sharingan and look at a player holding skills.")

local seen = {}

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            -- Scan EVERYTHING attached to their character
            for _, obj in ipairs(plr.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if not seen[obj] and (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("BillboardGui") or obj:IsA("StringValue") or obj:IsA("Folder")) then
                    seen[obj] = true
                    
                    local text = ""
                    if obj:IsA("TextLabel") then text = obj.Text end
                    if obj:IsA("StringValue") then text = tostring(obj.Value) end
                    
                    -- Only log if it actually has text or sounds like a skill slot
                    if text ~= "" or obj.Name:lower():find("skill") or obj.Name:lower():find("jutsu") or obj.Name:lower():find("sharingan") then
                        log("[" .. plr.Name .. "] " .. obj.ClassName .. " | Path: " .. obj:GetFullName() .. " | Text/Val: " .. text)
                    end
                end
            end
            
            -- Also check their workspace folder (sometimes GUIs are parented to Workspace.PlayerName)
            local wsPlayer = workspace:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
            if wsPlayer then
                for _, obj in ipairs(wsPlayer:GetDescendants()) do
                    if not seen[obj] and (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("BillboardGui")) then
                        seen[obj] = true
                        local text = obj:IsA("TextLabel") and obj.Text or ""
                        if text ~= "" then
                            log("[" .. plr.Name .. " WS] " .. obj.ClassName .. " | Path: " .. obj:GetFullName() .. " | Text: " .. text)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
```

[333] DeepSeek · 11/3/2026, 8:35:48 PM

You're right chef. We caught the weapon, but we didn't catch the hotbar jutsu changing. The reason is my last trace script only prints when it finds a new object. Once it found the skillName label holding a weapon, it ignored it when the text changed to a jutsu.

If the game shows it on the FakeHead.skillGUI, it updates the Text property. We just need to listen to that property.

Run this. It doesn't look for new objects. It hooks the exact Text property of that label. Tell your alt to swap hotbar slots, and watch the rconsole.

```lua
-- Hotbar Text Change Trace
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local function log(msg)
    pcall(function() rconsoleprint(tostring(msg) .. "\n") end)
end

log("=== HOTBAR TEXT TRACE STARTED ===")
log("Have someone swap hotbar slots or equip a jutsu.")

local hooked = {}

local function hookNameLabel(plrName)
    local char = workspace:FindFirstChild(plrName)
    if not char then return end
    
    local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
    if not fakeHead then return end
    
    local skillGui = fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
    if not skillGui then return end
    
    local skillName = skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
    if not skillName then return end
    
    if not hooked[skillName] then
        hooked[skillName] = true
        log("Hooked: " .. skillName:GetFullName())
        
        -- Print the initial state
        if skillName.Text ~= "" then
            log("Initial Text [" .. plrName .. "]: " .. skillName.Text)
        end
        
        -- Watch for changes!
        skillName:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
            if skillName.Text ~= "" then
                log("CHANGED [" .. plrName .. "]: " .. skillName.Text)
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- Keep checking for players joining or respawning
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        hookNameLabel(plr.Name)
    end
end)
```

what to do:

2. Watch someone fight. 
3. When they pull out a Jutsu (like Lightning Strike), it will print CHANGED [Name]: Lightning Strike.

If it prints the skill names when they swap, the ESP v8 will pick it up immediately. Try this and tell me what prints when they hold a jutsu.

```lua
-- ESP-Test-v9-FINAL.lua -- The Complete Package
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = {
    Enabled = true, Box = true, Health = true, Name = true, Distance = true,
    Highlight = false, Bloodline = true, Weapon = true, Traits = true, Jutsu = true,
    MaxDistance = 1500, Running = true,
    TextSize = 14, BoxThickness = 1, TextFont = 2, 
    TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
}

local fontNames = {"UI", "System", "Plex", "Monospace"}
local colorNames = {"White", "Red", "Green", "Cyan", "Purple", "Yellow"}
local colors = {
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80),
    Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 100)
}
local colorIndex = 1

-- ============ GUI ============
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ESPTest"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 1000
gui.Parent = CoreGui

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 520) -- taller for all features
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 100)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255); stroke.Parent = frame

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
title.Text = " KILLA ESP (FINAL)"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 11
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = frame

local list = Instance.new("Frame")
list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -70)
list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 30)
list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
list.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UIListLayout", list).Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)

local function createRow()
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
    f.Parent = list
    Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    return f
end

local function addToggle(name, key)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = " " .. name
    btn.TextColor3 = state[key] and Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    btn.Parent = list
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state[key] = not state[key]
        btn.TextColor3 = state[key] and Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end)
end

addToggle("Master Switch", "Enabled")
addToggle("Box ESP", "Box")
addToggle("Highlight (Chams)", "Highlight")
addToggle("Health Bar", "Health")
addToggle("Name", "Name")
addToggle("Distance", "Distance")
addToggle("Bloodline", "Bloodline")
addToggle("Weapon", "Weapon")
addToggle("Traits", "Traits")
addToggle("Jutsu Prediction", "Jutsu")

-- Distance Slider
local dRow = createRow()
local minus = Instance.new("TextButton"); minus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0); minus.Text = "-"; minus.Parent = dRow
local plus = Instance.new("TextButton"); plus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0); plus.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 0); plus.Text = "+"; plus.Parent = dRow
local dLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel"); dLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0); dLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 0); dLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dLabel.Text = "Max Dist: 1500"; dLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150,150,150); dLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code; dLabel.Parent = dRow

minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() state.MaxDistance = math.max(50, state.MaxDistance - 100); dLabel.Text = "Max Dist: " .. state.MaxDistance end)
plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() state.MaxDistance = state.MaxDistance + 100; dLabel.Text = "Max Dist: " .. state.MaxDistance end)

-- Text Size Slider
local tsRow = createRow()
local tsMinus = Instance.new("TextButton"); tsMinus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0); tsMinus.Text = "-"; tsMinus.Parent = tsRow
local tsPlus = Instance.new("TextButton"); tsPlus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0); tsPlus.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 0); tsPlus.Text = "+"; tsPlus.Parent = tsRow
local tsLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel"); tsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0); tsLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 0); tsLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tsLabel.Text = "Text Size: 14"; tsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150,150,150); tsLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code; tsLabel.Parent = tsRow

tsMinus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() state.TextSize = math.max(8, state.TextSize - 1); tsLabel.Text = "Text Size: " .. state.TextSize end)
tsPlus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() state.TextSize = state.TextSize + 1; tsLabel.Text = "Text Size: " .. state.TextSize end)

-- Font Cycler
local fontBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
fontBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); fontBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30); fontBtn.Text = "Font: Plex"; fontBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150); fontBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code; fontBtn.Parent = list
Instance.new("UICorner", fontBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
fontBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.TextFont = (state.TextFont + 1) % 4
    fontBtn.Text = "Font: " .. fontNames[state.TextFont + 1]
end)

-- Color Cycler
local colorBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
colorBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); colorBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30); colorBtn.Text = "Color: White"; colorBtn.TextColor3 = state.TextColor; colorBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code; colorBtn.Parent = list
Instance.new("UICorner", colorBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
colorBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    colorIndex = (colorIndex % #colors) + 1
    state.TextColor = colors[colorIndex]
    colorBtn.Text = "Color: " .. colorNames[colorIndex]
    colorBtn.TextColor3 = state.TextColor
end)

-- Unload Button
local unloadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
unloadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 25); unloadBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -30); unloadBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40); unloadBtn.Text = "UNLOAD ESP"; unloadBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); unloadBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; unloadBtn.TextSize = 11; unloadBtn.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", unloadBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

-- ============ DRAWING API ============
local espCache = {}
local highlightCache = {}

local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    tbl.Blood = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Blood.Center = true; tbl.Blood.Outline = true
    tbl.Weapon = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Weapon.Center = true; tbl.Weapon.Outline = true
    tbl.Traits = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Traits.Center = true; tbl.Traits.Outline = true
    tbl.Jutsu = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Jutsu.Center = true; tbl.Jutsu.Outline = true
    return tbl
end

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
end

local function updateHighlight(plr, char)
    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.Running = false
    for _, esp in pairs(espCache) do removeDrawings(esp) end
    for _, hl in pairs(highlightCache) do if hl then hl:Destroy() end end
    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}
    local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box & Health
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Jutsu (Top, Yellow) - SCRAPED FROM FAKEHEAD
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local skillGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
                                local skillName = skillGui and skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
                                
                                if skillName and skillName:IsA("TextLabel") and skillName.Text ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                    esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. skillName.Text .. "]"
                                    esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end
                            
                            -- Traits (Light Green)
                            esp.Traits.Visible = false
                            if state.Traits then
                                local traitsList = {}
                                for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                                    if child:IsA("StringValue") and child.Value == "" and child.Name ~= "Gender" and child.Name ~= "Wearing" then
                                        table.insert(traitsList, child.Name)
                                    end
                                end
                                if #traitsList > 0 then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize - 2)
                                    esp.Traits.Visible = true
                                    esp.Traits.Text = table.concat(traitsList, ", ")
                                    esp.Traits.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Traits.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Traits.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 150)
                                    esp.Traits.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline (Red)
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline then
                                local blood = "None"
                                for k,v in pairs(char:GetAttributes()) do
                                    if v == true and k ~= "Jumped" and k ~= "InsideWall" and k ~= "isRaining" and k ~= "otsuAnimations" and k ~= "Reanimated" and k ~= "FallDamageImmunity" and k ~= "BodyMoversImmunity" then 
                                        blood = k 
                                    end
                                end
                                if blood ~= "None" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = tostring(blood)
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Weapon (Light Blue)
                            esp.Weapon.Visible = false
                            if state.Weapon then
                                local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
                                local currentWeapon = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                if currentWeapon and currentWeapon.Value ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Weapon.Visible = true
                                    esp.Weapon.Text = tostring(currentWeapon.Value)
                                    esp.Weapon.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Weapon.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Weapon.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)
                                    esp.Weapon.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name (White)
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Weapon.Visible = false; esp.Traits.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

```lua
fontBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); fontBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30); fontBtn.Text = "Font: Plex"; fontBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150); fontBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code; fontBtn.Parent = list
Instance.new("UICorner", fontBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
fontBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.TextFont = (state.TextFont + 1) % 4
    fontBtn.Text = "Font: " .. fontNames[state.TextFont + 1]
end)

-- Color Cycler
local colorBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
colorBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); colorBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30); colorBtn.Text = "Color: White"; colorBtn.TextColor3 = state.TextColor; colorBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code; colorBtn.Parent = list
Instance.new("UICorner", colorBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
colorBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    colorIndex = (colorIndex % #colors) + 1
    state.TextColor = colors[colorIndex]
    colorBtn.Text = "Color: " .. colorNames[colorIndex]
    colorBtn.TextColor3 = state.TextColor
end)

-- Unload Button
local unloadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
unloadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 25); unloadBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -30); unloadBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40); unloadBtn.Text = "UNLOAD ESP"; unloadBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); unloadBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; unloadBtn.TextSize = 11; unloadBtn.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", unloadBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

-- ============ DRAWING API ============
local espCache = {}
local highlightCache = {}

local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    tbl.Blood = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Blood.Center = true; tbl.Blood.Outline = true
    tbl.Weapon = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Weapon.Center = true; tbl.Weapon.Outline = true
    tbl.Jutsu = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Jutsu.Center = true; tbl.Jutsu.Outline = true
    return tbl
end

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
end

local function updateHighlight(plr, char)
    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.Running = false
    for _, esp in pairs(espCache) do removeDrawings(esp) end
    for _, hl in pairs(highlightCache) do if hl then hl:Destroy() end end
    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}
    local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box & Health
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Jutsu (Top, Yellow)
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local skillGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
                                local skillName = skillGui and skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
                                
                                if skillName and skillName:IsA("TextLabel") and skillName.Text ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                    esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. skillName.Text .. "]"
                                    esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline (Red) with Reanimated formatting
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline then
                                local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
                                local bloodVal = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Bloodline")
                                local isReanimated = char:GetAttribute("Reanimated") == true
                                
                                local bloodText = nil
                                if bloodVal and bloodVal.Value ~= "" and bloodVal.Value ~= "None" then
                                    if isReanimated then
                                        bloodText = "Reanimated (" .. bloodVal.Value .. ")"
                                    else
                                        bloodText = bloodVal.Value
                                    end
                                elseif isReanimated then
                                    bloodText = "Reanimated"
                                end

                                if bloodText then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = bloodText
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Weapon (Light Blue)
                            esp.Weapon.Visible = false
                            if state.Weapon then
                                local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
                                local currentWeapon = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                if currentWeapon and currentWeapon.Value ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Weapon.Visible = true
                                    esp.Weapon.Text = tostring(currentWeapon.Value)
                                    esp.Weapon.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Weapon.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Weapon.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)
                                    esp.Weapon.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name (White)
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Weapon.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

```lua
                            if state.Weapon then
                                local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
                                local currentWeapon = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                if currentWeapon and currentWeapon.Value ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Weapon.Visible = true
                                    esp.Weapon.Text = tostring(currentWeapon.Value)
                                    esp.Weapon.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Weapon.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Weapon.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)
                                    esp.Weapon.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Weapon.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

```lua
local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    tbl.Blood = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Blood.Center = true; tbl.Blood.Outline = true
    tbl.Jutsu = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Jutsu.Center = true; tbl.Jutsu.Outline = true
    return tbl
end

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
end

local function updateHighlight(plr, char)
    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.Running = false
    for _, esp in pairs(espCache) do removeDrawings(esp) end
    for _, hl in pairs(highlightCache) do if hl then hl:Destroy() end end
    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}
    local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box & Health
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Jutsu
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local skillGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
                                local skillName = skillGui and skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
                                
                                if skillName and skillName:IsA("TextLabel") and skillName.Text ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                    esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. skillName.Text .. "]"
                                    esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline (No brackets)
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline then
                                local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
                                local bloodVal = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Bloodline")
                                local isReanimated = char:GetAttribute("Reanimated") == true
                                
                                local bloodText = nil
                                if bloodVal and bloodVal.Value ~= "" and bloodVal.Value ~= "None" then
                                    if isReanimated then
                                        bloodText = "Reanimated " .. bloodVal.Value
                                    else
                                        bloodText = bloodVal.Value
                                    end
                                elseif isReanimated then
                                    bloodText = "Reanimated"
                                end

                                if bloodText then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = bloodText
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

```lua
fontBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); fontBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30); fontBtn.Text = "Font: Plex"; fontBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150); fontBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code; fontBtn.Parent = list
Instance.new("UICorner", fontBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
fontBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.TextFont = (state.TextFont + 1) % 4
    fontBtn.Text = "Font: " .. fontNames[state.TextFont + 1]
end)

-- Color Cycler
local colorBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
colorBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); colorBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30); colorBtn.Text = "Color: White"; colorBtn.TextColor3 = state.TextColor; colorBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Code; colorBtn.Parent = list
Instance.new("UICorner", colorBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
colorBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    colorIndex = (colorIndex % #colors) + 1
    state.TextColor = colors[colorIndex]
    colorBtn.Text = "Color: " .. colorNames[colorIndex]
    colorBtn.TextColor3 = state.TextColor
end)

-- Unload Button
local unloadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
unloadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 25); unloadBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -30); unloadBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40); unloadBtn.Text = "UNLOAD ESP"; unloadBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); unloadBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; unloadBtn.TextSize = 11; unloadBtn.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", unloadBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

-- ============ DRAWING API ============
local espCache = {}
local highlightCache = {}

local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    tbl.Blood = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Blood.Center = true; tbl.Blood.Outline = true
    tbl.Jutsu = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Jutsu.Center = true; tbl.Jutsu.Outline = true
    tbl.Sub = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Sub.Center = true; tbl.Sub.Outline = true
    tbl.BloodPct = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.BloodPct.Center = true; tbl.BloodPct.Outline = true
    tbl.Combat = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Combat.Center = true; tbl.Combat.Outline = true
    return tbl
end

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
end

local function updateHighlight(plr, char)
    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.Running = false
    for _, esp in pairs(espCache) do removeDrawings(esp) end
    for _, hl in pairs(highlightCache) do if hl then hl:Destroy() end end
    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}
    local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]
                    
                    local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box & Health
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Jutsu
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local skillGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
                                local skillName = skillGui and skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
                                
                                if skillName and skillName:IsA("TextLabel") and skillName.Text ~= "" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                    esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. skillName.Text .. "]"
                                    esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                    esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Sub Cooldown
                            esp.Sub.Visible = false
                            if state.SubCD and plrSettings then
                                local subVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("SubCooldown")
                                if subVal and subVal.Value > 0 then
                                    local timeLeft = subVal.Value - tick()
                                    if timeLeft > 0 then
                                        topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                        esp.Sub.Visible = true
                                        esp.Sub.Text = string.format("Sub CD: %.1fs", timeLeft)
                                        esp.Sub.Size = state.TextSize
                                        esp.Sub.Font = state.TextFont
                                        esp.Sub.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100) -- Red
                                        esp.Sub.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            -- Blood %
                            esp.BloodPct.Visible = false
                            if state.Blood then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local bloodGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("bloodGUI")
                                local bloodText = bloodGui and bloodGui:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
                                if bloodText and bloodText.Text ~= "" and bloodText.Text ~= "0%" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.BloodPct.Visible = true
                                    esp.BloodPct.Text = "Blood: " .. bloodText.Text
                                    esp.BloodPct.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.BloodPct.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.BloodPct.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
                                    esp.BloodPct.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end
                            
                            -- Combat Timer
                            esp.Combat.Visible = false
                            if state.Combat and plrSettings then
                                local combatVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("OutOfCombat")
                                if combatVal and combatVal.Value > 0 then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Combat.Visible = true
                                    esp.Combat.Text = "COMBAT"
                                    esp.Combat.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Combat.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Combat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                                    esp.Combat.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline and plrSettings then
                                local bloodVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Bloodline")
                                local isReanimated = char:GetAttribute("Reanimated") == true
                                
                                local bloodText = nil
                                if bloodVal and bloodVal.Value ~= "" and bloodVal.Value ~= "None" then
                                    if isReanimated then
                                        bloodText = "Reanimated " .. bloodVal.Value
                                    else
                                        bloodText = bloodVal.Value
                                    end
                                elseif isReanimated then
                                    bloodText = "Reanimated"
                                end

                                if bloodText then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = bloodText
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                esp.Sub.Visible = false; esp.BloodPct.Visible = false; esp.Combat.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

what's new:
1. Sub CD: If they have a sub cooldown timer running, it shows a red timer above them.
2. Blood: Reads the bloodGUI percent we saw in the trace. If it's above 0%, it shows up.
3. Combat: Reads OutOfCombat. If it's above 0 (meaning they are in combat), it flashes "COMBAT" in red.

We basically cloned the entire Bishop ESP menu now. What do we want to tackle after this? The UI look (adding icons, etc.) or moving to the actual combat stuff (Infinite Jump bypass)?

[345] DeepSeek · 11/3/2026, 8:52:00 PM

Let's fix those two real quick. 

For the Sub Cooldown, the game uses a Unix timestamp. If you sub, it sets the timer to current_time + 8. The trace showed 1793733755, which means we need to subtract the current time from that value. I'll also add a filter so it doesn't show old timestamps if the game glitches.

For the Combat Timer, the trace showed OutOfCombat = 0 and RecentDamageDealer being populated. If OutOfCombat == 0 and they have a RecentDamageDealer, they are actively in combat.

Here is v14 with the fixes:
