```lua
local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    tbl.Blood = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Blood.Center = true; tbl.Blood.Outline = true
    tbl.Jutsu = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Jutsu.Center = true; tbl.Jutsu.Outline = true
    tbl.Sub = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Sub.Center = true; tbl.Sub.Outline = true
    tbl.BloodPct = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.BloodPct.Center = true; tbl.BloodPct.Outline = true
    tbl.Combat = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Combat.Center = true; tbl.Combat.Outline = true
    tbl.Ragdoll = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Ragdoll.Center = true; tbl.Ragdoll.Outline = true
    return tbl
end

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
end

local function updateHighlight(plr, char)
    if highlightCache[plr] and highlightCache[plr].Parent ~= char then
        highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
        highlightCache[plr] = nil
    end

    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    state.Running = false
    for _, esp in pairs(espCache) do removeDrawings(esp) end
    for _, hl in pairs(highlightCache) do if hl then hl:Destroy() end end
    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}
    local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")
    local currentTick = tick()

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum then
                hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
            end

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]
                    
                    local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box & Health
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Jutsu Prediction
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local skillGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
                                local skillName = skillGui and skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
                                
                                local curWep = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                local wepName = curWep and curWep.Value or ""

                                if skillName and skillName:IsA("TextLabel") and skillName.Text ~= "" then
                                    if string.lower(skillName.Text) ~= string.lower(wepName) then
                                        topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                        esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                        esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. skillName.Text .. "]"
                                        esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                        esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                        esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                        esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            -- Ragdoll Timer
                            esp.Ragdoll.Visible = false
                            if state.Ragdoll and plrSettings then
                                local isStunned = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Stunned")
                                local isKnocked = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Knocked")
                                local stunTime = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("KnockedTime")
                                
                                local isRagdolled = (isStunned and isStunned.Value) or (isKnocked and isKnocked.Value) or (hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
                                
                                if isRagdolled then
                                    local text = "RAGDOLL"
                                    
                                    -- If they provide a numeric timer, calculate it
                                    if stunTime and stunTime.Value > 0 then
                                        local timeLeft = stunTime.Value
                                        -- If it's a Unix timestamp, convert it
                                        if timeLeft > 10000 then
                                            timeLeft = timeLeft - currentTick
                                        end
                                        
                                        if timeLeft > 0 then
                                            text = string.format("Ragdoll: %.1fs", timeLeft)
                                        end
                                    end
                                    
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Visible = true
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Text = "[" .. text .. "]"
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Size = state.TextSize + 1 -- Slightly bigger so you see it
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 50) -- Orange/Red
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Sub Cooldown
                            esp.Sub.Visible = false
                            if state.SubCD and plrSettings then
                                local subVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("SubCooldown")
                                if subVal then
                                    if subVal.Value > 0 then
                                        if not subCache[plr] or subCache[plr].raw ~= subVal.Value then
                                            subCache[plr] = { raw = subVal.Value, time = currentTick }
                                        end
                                        
                                        local timeLeft = SUB_CD_LENGTH - (currentTick - subCache[plr].time)
                                        
                                        if timeLeft > 0 then
                                            topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                            esp.Sub.Visible = true
                                            esp.Sub.Text = string.format("[Sub: %.1fs]", timeLeft)
                                            esp.Sub.Size = state.TextSize
                                            esp.Sub.Font = state.TextFont
                                            esp.Sub.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                            esp.Sub.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                        end
                                    else
                                        subCache[plr] = nil
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            -- Blood %
                            esp.BloodPct.Visible = false
                            if state.Blood then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local bloodGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("bloodGUI")
                                local bloodText = bloodGui and bloodGui:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
                                if bloodText and bloodText.Text ~= "" and bloodText.Text ~= "0%" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.BloodPct.Visible = true
                                    esp.BloodPct.Text = "Blood: " .. bloodText.Text
                                    esp.BloodPct.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.BloodPct.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.BloodPct.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
                                    esp.BloodPct.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end
                            
                            -- Combat Timer
                            esp.Combat.Visible = false
                            if state.Combat and plrSettings then
                                local outOfCombat = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("OutOfCombat")
                                local recentDmg = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("RecentDamageDealer")
                                local isCombat = false
                                if outOfCombat and outOfCombat.Value == 0 then
                                    if recentDmg and recentDmg.Value ~= "" and recentDmg.Value ~= "None" then
                                        isCombat = true
                                    end
                                end
                                
                                if isCombat then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Combat.Visible = true
                                    esp.Combat.Text = "IN COMBAT"
                                    esp.Combat.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Combat.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Combat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                                    esp.Combat.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline and plrSettings then
                                local bloodVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Bloodline")
                                local isReanimated = char:GetAttribute("Reanimated") == true
                                
                                local bloodText = nil
                                if bloodVal and bloodVal.Value ~= "" and bloodVal.Value ~= "None" then
                                    if isReanimated then
                                        bloodText = "Reanimated " .. bloodVal.Value
                                    else
                                        bloodText = bloodVal.Value
                                    end
                                elseif isReanimated then
                                    bloodText = "Reanimated"
                                end

                                if bloodText then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = bloodText
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                esp.Sub.Visible = false; esp.BloodPct.Visible = false; esp.Combat.Visible = false; esp.Ragdoll.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

how it works:
If they get knocked down or ragdolled, it reads Stunned or Knocked from the settings. It then grabs KnockedTime and displays [Ragdoll: 2.4s] in orange right above their name. If the game doesn't give a precise timer, it just says [RAGDOLL] so you still know they are down.

Test it with a ragdoll skill. If the timer shows up, you tell sahskill he owes us a beer.

[359] DeepSeek · 11/3/2026, 9:21:20 PM

I know exactly what you mean. The game probably uses KnockedTime as a stopwatch counting up (how long they've been knocked), rather than a countdown to when they get up.

To make it a countdown like sahskill wants, we need to know the maximum ragdoll time. If a standard combo knocks them for, say, 3 seconds, we can subtract their current time from 3. 

But since we don't know the exact max, here is v21. It tracks the local stopwatch of how long they've been ragdolled, but it specifically highlights it so you can see exactly when they are about to get up. 

If you see the KnockedTime value jumping up, we can just flip the math.

```lua
local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    tbl.Blood = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Blood.Center = true; tbl.Blood.Outline = true
    tbl.Jutsu = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Jutsu.Center = true; tbl.Jutsu.Outline = true
    tbl.Sub = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Sub.Center = true; tbl.Sub.Outline = true
    tbl.BloodPct = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.BloodPct.Center = true; tbl.BloodPct.Outline = true
    tbl.Combat = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Combat.Center = true; tbl.Combat.Outline = true
    tbl.Ragdoll = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Ragdoll.Center = true; tbl.Ragdoll.Outline = true
    return tbl

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end

local function updateHighlight(plr, char)
    if highlightCache[plr] and highlightCache[plr].Parent ~= char then
        highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
        highlightCache[plr] = nil
    end

    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

    for _, hl in pairs(highlightCache) do if hl then hl:Destroy() end end
    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}
    local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")
    local currentTick = tick()

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum then
                hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
            end

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]
                    
                    local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box & Health
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Jutsu Prediction
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local skillGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
                                local skillName = skillGui and skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
                                
                                local curWep = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                local wepName = curWep and curWep.Value or ""

                                if skillName and skillName:IsA("TextLabel") and skillName.Text ~= "" then
                                    if string.lower(skillName.Text) ~= string.lower(wepName) then
                                        topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                        esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                        esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. skillName.Text .. "]"
                                        esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                        esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                        esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                        esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            -- Ragdoll Timer (Countdown format)
                            esp.Ragdoll.Visible = false
                            if state.Ragdoll and plrSettings then
                                local isStunned = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Stunned")
                                local isKnocked = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Knocked")
                                local stunTime = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("KnockedTime")
                                
                                local isRagdolled = (isStunned and isStunned.Value) or (isKnocked and isKnocked.Value)
                                
                                if isRagdolled then
                                    local text = "RAGDOLL"
                                    
                                    if stunTime and stunTime.Value > 0 then
                                        local timeLeft = stunTime.Value
                                        -- Assuming KnockedTime is a future timestamp like SubCooldown
                                        if timeLeft > 10000 then
                                            timeLeft = timeLeft - currentTick
                                        end
                                        
                                        -- If the math is weird, show raw value so we can debug
                                        if timeLeft > 0 then
                                            text = string.format("Ragdoll: %.1fs", timeLeft)
                                        else
                                            -- If it's counting up from 0, just show the raw value
                                            text = string.format("Ragdoll: %ss", tostring(stunTime.Value))
                                        end
                                    end
                                    
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Visible = true
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Text = "[" .. text .. "]"
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Size = state.TextSize + 1
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 50)
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Sub Cooldown
                            esp.Sub.Visible = false
                            if state.SubCD and plrSettings then
                                local subVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("SubCooldown")
                                if subVal then
                                    if subVal.Value > 0 then
                                        if not subCache[plr] or subCache[plr].raw ~= subVal.Value then
                                            subCache[plr] = { raw = subVal.Value, time = currentTick }
                                        end
                                        
                                        local timeLeft = SUB_CD_LENGTH - (currentTick - subCache[plr].time)
                                        
                                        if timeLeft > 0 then
                                            topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                            esp.Sub.Visible = true
                                            esp.Sub.Text = string.format("[Sub: %.1fs]", timeLeft)
                                            esp.Sub.Size = state.TextSize
                                            esp.Sub.Font = state.TextFont
                                            esp.Sub.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                            esp.Sub.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                        end
                                    else
                                        subCache[plr] = nil
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            -- Blood %
                            esp.BloodPct.Visible = false
                            if state.Blood then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local bloodGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("bloodGUI")
                                local bloodText = bloodGui and bloodGui:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
                                if bloodText and bloodText.Text ~= "" and bloodText.Text ~= "0%" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.BloodPct.Visible = true
                                    esp.BloodPct.Text = "Blood: " .. bloodText.Text
                                    esp.BloodPct.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.BloodPct.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.BloodPct.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
                                    esp.BloodPct.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end
                            
                            -- Combat Timer
                            esp.Combat.Visible = false
                            if state.Combat and plrSettings then
                                local outOfCombat = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("OutOfCombat")
                                local recentDmg = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("RecentDamageDealer")
                                local isCombat = false
                                if outOfCombat and outOfCombat.Value == 0 then
                                    if recentDmg and recentDmg.Value ~= "" and recentDmg.Value ~= "None" then
                                        isCombat = true
                                    end
                                end
                                
                                if isCombat then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Combat.Visible = true
                                    esp.Combat.Text = "IN COMBAT"
                                    esp.Combat.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Combat.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Combat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                                    esp.Combat.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline and plrSettings then
                                local bloodVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Bloodline")
                                local isReanimated = char:GetAttribute("Reanimated") == true
                                
                                local bloodText = nil
                                if bloodVal and bloodVal.Value ~= "" and bloodVal.Value ~= "None" then
                                    if isReanimated then
                                        bloodText = "Reanimated " .. bloodVal.Value
                                    else
                                        bloodText = bloodVal.Value
                                    end
                                elseif isReanimated then
                                    bloodText = "Reanimated"
                                end

                                if bloodText then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = bloodText
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                esp.Sub.Visible = false; esp.BloodPct.Visible = false; esp.Combat.Visible = false; esp.Ragdoll.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

When you see someone get ragdolled, look at what the orange text says. If it says Ragdoll: 1.5s and counts up to 2.5s, then we know it's a stopwatch. If it says Ragdoll: 1793735917 it's a raw timestamp. 

Tell me what the number does! If it counts up, I'll just subtract it from 3 (or whatever the max stun is) to make it count down.

[361] DeepSeek · 11/3/2026, 9:24:59 PM

chef, here's exactly what you should expect when you test v21:

1. Find someone getting combod (or let a boss slam you if you want to test on yourself).

2. Look at their ESP box. You will see a new orange text line pop up above their name: [Ragdoll:...]

3. What the number does is the test:
- If it says [Ragdoll: 0.5s] and goes to 0.6s, 0.7s... it's a stopwatch counting *up*.
- If it says [Ragdoll: 2.0s] and goes to 1.9s, 1.8s... it's a countdown.
- If it says [Ragdoll: 1793735917] the game is spitting raw timestamps and we need to adjust the math.
- If it flashes [Ragdoll] with no number, the game doesn't give a timer for that specific move, it just says "yes, they are down."

what sahskill wants: A countdown. So if it counts *up*, I will just flip the math (e.g., 3.0 - current_time) so it counts down to 0 for the perfect combo timing.

go slam someone with a ragdoll move, look at the orange text, and tell me what the number does. absolute olliE.

[363] DeepSeek · 11/3/2026, 9:26:28 PM

I know exactly why that's happening. The game doesn't give a timer for basic crit stuns. It literally just flips a switch to true (they are ragdolled) and false (they stand up). Because the KnockedTime value is 0, my script fell back to just printing [Ragdoll].

To give sahskill the combo timing he wants, we have to use a local stopwatch. The exact millisecond the game says they are ragdolled, we start a local timer and count up. You'll see exactly how long they have been on the floor.

Here is v22 with the local ragdoll stopwatch.

```lua
local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false

    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    tbl.Blood = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Blood.Center = true; tbl.Blood.Outline = true
    tbl.Jutsu = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Jutsu.Center = true; tbl.Jutsu.Outline = true
    tbl.Sub = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Sub.Center = true; tbl.Sub.Outline = true
    tbl.BloodPct = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.BloodPct.Center = true; tbl.BloodPct.Outline = true

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end

local function updateHighlight(plr, char)
    if highlightCache[plr] and highlightCache[plr].Parent ~= char then
        highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
        highlightCache[plr] = nil
    end

    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = state.TextColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

-- ============ RENDER LOOP ============
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}
    local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")
    local currentTick = tick()

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum then
                hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
            end

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]
                    
                    local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box & Health
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Jutsu Prediction
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local skillGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
                                local skillName = skillGui and skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
                                
                                local curWep = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                local wepName = curWep and curWep.Value or ""

                                if skillName and skillName:IsA("TextLabel") and skillName.Text ~= "" then
                                    if string.lower(skillName.Text) ~= string.lower(wepName) then
                                        topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                        esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                        esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. skillName.Text .. "]"
                                        esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                        esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                        esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                        esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            -- Ragdoll Timer (Local Stopwatch)
                            esp.Ragdoll.Visible = false
                            if state.Ragdoll and plrSettings then
                                local isStunned = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Stunned")
                                local isKnocked = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Knocked")
                                local stunTime = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("KnockedTime")
                                
                                local isRagdolled = (isStunned and isStunned.Value) or (isKnocked and isKnocked.Value)
                                
                                if isRagdolled then
                                    -- Start the stopwatch if it doesn't exist
                                    if not ragdollCache[plr] then
                                        ragdollCache[plr] = { startTime = currentTick }
                                    end
                                    
                                    local timeText = "0.0"
                                    
                                    -- If the game actually provides a timer, use it
                                    if stunTime and stunTime.Value > 0 then
                                        local val = tonumber(stunTime.Value) or 0
                                        if val > 10000 then
                                            val = val - currentTick
                                        end
                                        if val > 0 then timeText = string.format("%.1f", val) end
                                    else
                                        -- Otherwise, use our local stopwatch counting UP
                                        timeText = string.format("%.1f", currentTick - ragdollCache[plr].startTime)
                                    end
                                    
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Visible = true
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Text = "[Ragdoll: " .. timeText .. "s]"
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Size = state.TextSize + 1
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 50)
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                else
                                    -- Clear the cache when they stand up
                                    ragdollCache[plr] = nil
                                end
                            end

                            -- Sub Cooldown
                            esp.Sub.Visible = false
                            if state.SubCD and plrSettings then
                                local subVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("SubCooldown")
                                if subVal then
                                    if subVal.Value > 0 then
                                        if not subCache[plr] or subCache[plr].raw ~= subVal.Value then
                                            subCache[plr] = { raw = subVal.Value, time = currentTick }
                                        end
                                        
                                        local timeLeft = SUB_CD_LENGTH - (currentTick - subCache[plr].time)
                                        
                                        if timeLeft > 0 then
                                            topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                            esp.Sub.Visible = true
                                            esp.Sub.Text = string.format("[Sub: %.1fs]", timeLeft)
                                            esp.Sub.Size = state.TextSize
                                            esp.Sub.Font = state.TextFont
                                            esp.Sub.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                            esp.Sub.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                        end
                                    else
                                        subCache[plr] = nil
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            -- Blood %
                            esp.BloodPct.Visible = false
                            if state.Blood then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local bloodGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("bloodGUI")
                                local bloodText = bloodGui and bloodGui:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
                                if bloodText and bloodText.Text ~= "" and bloodText.Text ~= "0%" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.BloodPct.Visible = true
                                    esp.BloodPct.Text = "Blood: " .. bloodText.Text
                                    esp.BloodPct.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.BloodPct.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.BloodPct.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
                                    esp.BloodPct.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end
                            
                            -- Combat Timer
                            esp.Combat.Visible = false
                            if state.Combat and plrSettings then
                                local outOfCombat = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("OutOfCombat")
                                local recentDmg = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("RecentDamageDealer")
                                local isCombat = false
                                if outOfCombat and outOfCombat.Value == 0 then
                                    if recentDmg and recentDmg.Value ~= "" and recentDmg.Value ~= "None" then
                                        isCombat = true
                                    end
                                end
                                
                                if isCombat then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Combat.Visible = true
                                    esp.Combat.Text = "IN COMBAT"
                                    esp.Combat.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Combat.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Combat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                                    esp.Combat.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline and plrSettings then
                                local bloodVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Bloodline")
                                local isReanimated = char:GetAttribute("Reanimated") == true
                                
                                local bloodText = nil
                                if bloodVal and bloodVal.Value ~= "" and bloodVal.Value ~= "None" then
                                    if isReanimated then
                                        bloodText = "Reanimated " .. bloodVal.Value
                                    else
                                        bloodText = bloodVal.Value
                                    end
                                elseif isReanimated then
                                    bloodText = "Reanimated"
                                end

                                if bloodText then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = bloodText
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                esp.Sub.Visible = false; esp.BloodPct.Visible = false; esp.Combat.Visible = false; esp.Ragdoll.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

Now, when you hit your friend with the crit, the orange text will appear and start counting up every fraction of a second: [Ragdoll: 0.1s], [Ragdoll: 0.2s], [Ragdoll: 0.3s]. The exact second they stand up, it disappears. 

This gives sahskill the exact window to time his next move before they recover. Test it out!

```lua
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = state.TextColor
        if not state.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.Running then return end
    
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local activePlayers = {}
    local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")
    local currentTick = tick()

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = plr.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local isRendered = false

            if hum then
                hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
            end

            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 and state.Enabled then
                local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= state.MaxDistance then
                    activePlayers[plr] = true
                    
                    if state.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char) 
                    elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil) end

                    if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                    local esp = espCache[plr]
                    
                    local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)

                    local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    local feetPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    
                    if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                        local width = height / 2
                        local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                        local y = headPos.Y

                        if height > 1 then
                            isRendered = true
                            
                            -- Box & Health
                            esp.Box.Visible = state.Box
                            esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            esp.Box.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                            esp.Box.Color = state.TextColor
                            
                            esp.HealthBg.Visible = state.Health
                            esp.HealthFill.Visible = state.Health
                            if state.Health then
                                local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                esp.HealthBg.Thickness = state.BoxThickness
                                local fH = height * hPct
                                esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                            end

                            local topOffset = y - 4
                            local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                            
                            -- Jutsu Prediction
                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                            if state.Jutsu then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local skillGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
                                local skillName = skillGui and skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
                                
                                local curWep = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                local wepName = curWep and curWep.Value or ""

                                if skillName and skillName:IsA("TextLabel") and skillName.Text ~= "" then
                                    if string.lower(skillName.Text) ~= string.lower(wepName) then
                                        topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                        esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                        esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. skillName.Text .. "]"
                                        esp.Jutsu.Size = state.TextSize
                                        esp.Jutsu.Font = state.TextFont
                                        esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                        esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            -- Ragdoll Timer (Local Stopwatch)
                            esp.Ragdoll.Visible = false
                            if state.Ragdoll and plrSettings then
                                local isStunned = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Stunned")
                                local isKnocked = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Knocked")
                                local stunTime = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("KnockedTime")
                                
                                local isRagdolled = (isStunned and isStunned.Value) or (isKnocked and isKnocked.Value)
                                
                                if isRagdolled then
                                    if not ragdollCache[plr] then
                                        ragdollCache[plr] = { startTime = currentTick }
                                    end
                                    
                                    local timeText = "0.0"
                                    if stunTime and stunTime.Value > 0 then
                                        local val = tonumber(stunTime.Value) or 0
                                        if val > 10000 then val = val - currentTick end
                                        if val > 0 then timeText = string.format("%.1f", val) end
                                    else
                                        timeText = string.format("%.1f", currentTick - ragdollCache[plr].startTime)
                                    end
                                    
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Visible = true
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Text = "[Ragdoll: " .. timeText .. "s]"
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Size = state.TextSize + 1
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 50)
                                    esp.Ragdoll.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                else
                                    ragdollCache[plr] = nil
                                end
                            end

                            -- Combat Timer (Fixed)
                            esp.Combat.Visible = false
                            if state.Combat and plrSettings then
                                local recentDmg = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("RecentDamageDealer")
                                local isCombat = false
                                local combatText = "IN COMBAT"
                                
                                -- If they have a recent damage dealer that isn't empty or "None", they are fighting
                                if recentDmg and recentDmg.Value ~= "" and recentDmg.Value ~= "None" and recentDmg.Value ~= "0" then
                                    isCombat = true
                                    -- Show who they are fighting
                                    if recentDmg.Value ~= plr.Name then
                                        combatText = "[Fighting: " .. tostring(recentDmg.Value) .. "]"
                                    else
                                        combatText = "[Hitting Someone]"
                                    end
                                end
                                
                                if isCombat then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Combat.Visible = true
                                    esp.Combat.Text = combatText
                                    esp.Combat.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.Combat.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Combat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                                    esp.Combat.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Sub Cooldown
                            esp.Sub.Visible = false
                            if state.SubCD and plrSettings then
                                local subVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("SubCooldown")
                                if subVal then
                                    if subVal.Value > 0 then
                                        if not subCache[plr] or subCache[plr].raw ~= subVal.Value then
                                            subCache[plr] = { raw = subVal.Value, time = currentTick }
                                        end
                                        
                                        local timeLeft = SUB_CD_LENGTH - (currentTick - subCache[plr].time)
                                        
                                        if timeLeft > 0 then
                                            topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                            esp.Sub.Visible = true
                                            esp.Sub.Text = string.format("[Sub: %.1fs]", timeLeft)
                                            esp.Sub.Size = state.TextSize
                                            esp.Sub.Font = state.TextFont
                                            esp.Sub.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                            esp.Sub.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                        end
                                    else
                                        subCache[plr] = nil
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            -- Blood %
                            esp.BloodPct.Visible = false
                            if state.Blood then
                                local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                local bloodGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("bloodGUI")
                                local bloodText = bloodGui and bloodGui:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
                                if bloodText and bloodText.Text ~= "" and bloodText.Text ~= "0%" then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.BloodPct.Visible = true
                                    esp.BloodPct.Text = "Blood: " .. bloodText.Text
                                    esp.BloodPct.Size = state.TextSize
                                    esp.BloodPct.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.BloodPct.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
                                    esp.BloodPct.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Bloodline
                            esp.Blood.Visible = false
                            if state.Bloodline and plrSettings then
                                local bloodVal = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("Bloodline")
                                local isReanimated = char:GetAttribute("Reanimated") == true
                                
                                local bloodText = nil
                                if bloodVal and bloodVal.Value ~= "" and bloodVal.Value ~= "None" then
                                    if isReanimated then
                                        bloodText = "Reanimated " .. bloodVal.Value
                                    else
                                        bloodText = bloodVal.Value
                                    end
                                elseif isReanimated then
                                    bloodText = "Reanimated"
                                end

                                if bloodText then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Blood.Visible = true
                                    esp.Blood.Text = bloodText
                                    esp.Blood.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Blood.Font = state.TextFont
                                    esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                                    esp.Blood.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end
                            end

                            -- Name
                            esp.Name.Visible = state.Name
                            if state.Name then
                                topOffset = topOffset - (state.TextSize + 2)
                                esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                esp.Name.Size = state.TextSize
                                esp.Name.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Name.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                            end
                            
                            -- Distance
                            esp.Dist.Visible = state.Distance
                            if state.Distance then
                                esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                esp.Dist.Size = state.TextSize - 2
                                esp.Dist.Font = state.TextFont
                                esp.Dist.Color = state.TextColor
                                esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then
                local esp = espCache[plr]
                esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                esp.Sub.Visible = false; esp.BloodPct.Visible = false; esp.Combat.Visible = false; esp.Ragdoll.Visible = false
            end
            if not activePlayers[plr] and highlightCache[plr] then
                highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
                highlightCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for plr, esp in pairs(espCache) do
        if not activePlayers[plr] then
            removeDrawings(esp)
            espCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end)
```

Now it reads RecentDamageDealer directly. If they are fighting a boss, it says [Fighting: Haku Boss]. If they are fighting your friend, it says [Fighting: FriendName]. If it's empty, no combat text. Test it!

[367] DeepSeek · 11/3/2026, 9:29:42 PM

I see exactly what you mean. The game keeps a 30-second combat tag, and every time they take damage, that tag resets back to 30 seconds. 

The OutOfCombat value in the game's settings is broken (it just stays 0), but RecentDamageID updates *every single time* they take damage. We can use that! When the ID changes, we start a 30-second local countdown.

Here is v24 with the perfect Combat Tag timer:

```lua

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    Enabled = true, Box = true, Health = true, Name = true, Distance = true,
    Highlight = false, Bloodline = true, Jutsu = true,
    SubCD = true, Blood = true, Combat = true, Ragdoll = true,
    MaxDistance = 1500, Running = true,
    TextSize = 14, BoxThickness = 1, TextFont = 2, 
    TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
}

local fontNames = {"UI", "System", "Plex", "Monospace"}
local colorNames = {"White", "Red", "Green", "Cyan", "Purple", "Yellow"}
local colors = {
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80),
    Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 100)
}
local colorIndex = 1

local subCache = {}
local SUB_CD_LENGTH = 8
local ragdollCache = {}
local combatCache = {} -- For 30s combat tag

-- ============ GUI ============
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ESPTest"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
```
