```lua
if not isfolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) then makefolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) end

-- =============================================================
-- KILLA Flex V3.1 Learner Module
-- =============================================================
local Learner = (function()
    local Learner = {}
    Learner.__index = Learner

    local CFG = {
        SCHEMA = 4,
        DELAY_MIN = -0.50, DELAY_MAX = 2.00,
        A_MIN = -0.50, A_MAX = 1.00,
        B_MIN = 0.005, B_MAX = 0.020,
        B_OFFSET = 20,
        FAR_THRESHOLD = 40,
        A_FAR_WEIGHT = 0.2,
        BASE_SLOPE = 0.015,
        HOLD_MIN = 0.30, HOLD_MAX = 0.45,
        GAIN = 0.35,
        STEP_SCALE_MIN = 0.25, STEP_SCALE_RECOVER = 1.15,
        RECOVER_AFTER = 4,
        DEADBAND_MS = 20,
        MIN_SAMPLES = 8,
        HOLD_ERR_BAND = 60,
        HOLD_UP = 0.015, HOLD_DOWN = 0.010,
        HOLD_UP_AFTER = 2, HOLD_DOWN_AFTER = 3,
        EARLY_CONFIRM = 2, EARLY_STRONG_MS = 250, EARLY_WEIGHT = 0.5,
        DEDUP_MS = 200,
        SPAWN_GRACE = 1.0,
        LAG_MULT = 1.5, LAG_ABS_MS = 80,
        CROWD_STUDS = 20,
        MAX_PLAUSIBLE_ERR_MS = 2000,
        SAVE_DEBOUNCE = 1.0,
        DIR = "KILLA Flex DB",
    }
    local clock = os.clock

    local function clamp(v, lo, hi)
        if v < lo then return lo end
        if v > hi then return hi end
        return v
    end
    local function round3(v) return math.floor(v * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000 end
    local function checksum(s)
        local h = 2166136261
        for i = 1, #s do
            h = bit32.bxor(h, string.byte(s, i))
            h = bit32.band(h * 16777619, 0xFFFFFFFF)
        end
        return h
    end

    function Learner.new(opts)
        local self = setmetatable({}, Learner)
        opts = opts or {}
        self.enabled = true
        self.models = {}
        self.skips = {}
        self.dirty = false
        self.lastSave = 0
        self.lagSamples = {}
        self.inRound = false
        self.spawnAt = 0
        self.lastEvent = {}
        self.lagCooldownUntil = 0
        self.dbPath = CFG.DIR .. "/db.txt"
        self.bakPath = self.dbPath .. ".bak"
        self.tmpPath = self.dbPath .. ".tmp"
        self:_ensureDir()
        self:_load()
        if opts.autoSave ~= false then
            task.spawn(function()
                while true do
                    task.wait(CFG.SAVE_DEBOUNCE)
                    if self.dirty then self:Save() end
                end
            end)
        end
        return self
    end

    function Learner:_ensureDir()
        if isfolder and not isfolder(CFG.DIR) then pcall(makefolder, CFG.DIR) end
    end

    function Learner:_model(skillId, baseSlope, seedA)
        skillId = skillId or "global"
        local m = self.models[skillId]
        if not m then
            m = {
                id = skillId,
                a = clamp(seedA or 0, CFG.A_MIN, CFG.A_MAX),
                b = clamp(baseSlope or CFG.BASE_SLOPE, CFG.B_MIN, CFG.B_MAX),
                n = 0, scale = 1, dir = 0, sameRun = 0,
                hold = CFG.HOLD_MIN, holdPrev = nil,
                holdRun = 0, holdDownRun = 0,
                pendErr = 0, pendN = 0, lastSeen = 0,
            }
            self.models[skillId] = m
        elseif baseSlope and m.n == 0 then
            m.b = clamp(baseSlope, CFG.B_MIN, CFG.B_MAX)
        end
        return m
    end

    function Learner:Gate(ev)
        if not self.enabled then return false, "disabled" end
        if not self.inRound then return false, "not_in_round" end
        if clock() - self.spawnAt < CFG.SPAWN_GRACE then return false, "spawn_grace" end
        if clock() < self.lagCooldownUntil then return false, "lag_cooldown" end
        local rtt = ev.rttMs
        if rtt and rtt > 0 then
            table.insert(self.lagSamples, rtt)
            if #self.lagSamples > 24 then table.remove(self.lagSamples, 1) end
            if #self.lagSamples >= 6 then
                local sorted = table.clone(self.lagSamples)
                table.sort(sorted)
                local med = sorted[math.ceil(#sorted / 2)]
                if rtt > med * CFG.LAG_MULT + CFG.LAG_ABS_MS then
                    self.lagCooldownUntil = clock() + 2.0
                    return false, "lag_spike"
                end
            end
        end
        if ev.unparryable then return false, "unparryable" end
        if ev.whiff then return false, "whiff" end
        if ev.parryLocked then return false, "anim_lock" end
        if ev.dead then return false, "dead" end
        if ev.skillId then
            local now = clock()
            local t = self.lastEvent[ev.skillId]
            if t and (now - t) * 1000 < CFG.DEDUP_MS then return false, "dedup" end
            self.lastEvent[ev.skillId] = now
        end
        if not ev.attackerKnown then
            local near = 0
            for _, other in ipairs(ev.castersNear or {}) do
                if other.dist <= CFG.CROWD_STUDS and other.facing ~= false then
                    near += 1
                    if near > 1 then return false, "crowd" end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    function Learner:Observe(ev)
        local valid, reason = self:Gate(ev)
        if not valid then self.skips[reason] = (self.skips[reason] or 0) + 1; return false, reason end
        local m = self:_model(ev.skillId)
        local now = clock()
        m.n += 1
        m.lastSeen = now
        self.dirty = true
        local outcome = ev.outcome
        if outcome == "perfect" then self:_onPerfect(m, now)
        elseif outcome == "late" then self:_onLate(m, ev, now)
        elseif outcome == "early" then self:_onEarly(m, ev, now) end
        return true
    end

    local function signedErr(ev)
        if ev.inputTime and ev.hitTime then
            local e = (ev.inputTime - ev.hitTime) * 1000
            if math.abs(e) > CFG.MAX_PLAUSIBLE_ERR_MS then return nil end
            return e
        end
        return nil
    end

    function Learner:_fit(m, errMs, dist, weight)
        if not errMs or math.abs(errMs) < CFG.DEADBAND_MS then return end
        local err = (errMs / 1000) * (weight or 1)
        local d = dist or 0
        local dn = clamp((d - CFG.B_OFFSET) / 60, 0, 2)

        if (errMs > 0) ~= (m.dir > 0) then
            m.scale = math.max(m.scale * 0.5, CFG.STEP_SCALE_MIN)
            m.sameRun = 0
        else
            m.sameRun += 1
            if m.sameRun >= CFG.RECOVER_AFTER then
                m.scale = math.min(m.scale * CFG.STEP_SCALE_RECOVER, 1)
                m.sameRun = 0
            end
        end
        m.dir = errMs > 0 and -1 or 1
        if math.abs(errMs) > 100 and m.sameRun >= 3 then
            m.scale = 1.0
            m.sameRun = 0
        end

        local k = CFG.GAIN * m.scale
        local aWeight = (d <= CFG.FAR_THRESHOLD) and 1.0 or CFG.A_FAR_WEIGHT
        local maxStepA = 0.15
        local maxStepB = 0.008
        local stepA = clamp(-k * err * aWeight, -maxStepA, maxStepA)
        local stepB = clamp(-k * err * dn, -maxStepB, maxStepB)
        m.a = clamp(m.a + stepA, CFG.A_MIN, CFG.A_MAX)
        m.b = clamp(m.b + stepB, CFG.B_MIN, CFG.B_MAX)
    end

    function Learner:_onPerfect(m, now)
        m.pendErr, m.pendN = 0, 0
        m.holdRun = 0
        m.holdPrev = nil
        m.holdDownRun = (m.holdDownRun or 0) + 1
        if m.holdDownRun >= CFG.HOLD_DOWN_AFTER then
            m.hold = math.max(m.hold - CFG.HOLD_DOWN, CFG.HOLD_MIN)
            m.holdDownRun = 0
        end
    end

    function Learner:_onLate(m, ev, now)
        m.pendErr, m.pendN = 0, 0
        m.holdDownRun = 0
        local err = signedErr(ev)
        if not err then return end
        self:_fit(m, err, ev.dist or 0)
        if math.abs(err) <= CFG.HOLD_ERR_BAND then
            m.holdRun = (m.holdRun or 0) + 1
            if m.holdRun >= CFG.HOLD_UP_AFTER then
                m.holdPrev = m.hold
                m.hold = math.min(m.hold + CFG.HOLD_UP, CFG.HOLD_MAX)
                m.holdRun = 0
            end
        else
            m.holdRun = 0
        end
    end

    function Learner:_onEarly(m, ev, now)
        m.holdDownRun = 0
        local err = signedErr(ev)
        if err then
            m.pendErr += err
            m.pendN += 1
            if m.pendN >= CFG.EARLY_CONFIRM or math.abs(err) > CFG.EARLY_STRONG_MS then
                self:_fit(m, (m.pendErr / m.pendN) * CFG.EARLY_WEIGHT, ev.dist or 0)
                m.pendErr, m.pendN = 0, 0
            end
        end
        if m.holdPrev then
            m.hold = m.holdPrev
            m.holdPrev = nil
        end
    end

    function Learner:Predict(skillId, dist, baseSlope, seedA)
        local m = self:_model(skillId, baseSlope, seedA)
        local eff = math.max(0, (dist or 0) - CFG.B_OFFSET)
        local raw = m.a + m.b * eff
        return {
            delay = clamp(raw, CFG.DELAY_MIN, CFG.DELAY_MAX),
            hold = m.hold, key = m.id,
            confidence = math.min(m.n / CFG.MIN_SAMPLES, 1),
            samples = m.n, a = m.a, b = m.b,
        }
    end

    function Learner:OnRoundStart() self.inRound = true; self.spawnAt = clock() end
    function Learner:OnRoundEnd() self.inRound = false end
    function Learner:OnSpawn() self.spawnAt = clock() end
    function Learner:SetEnabled(v) self.enabled = v end

    function Learner:Stats()
        local rows = {}
        for _, m in pairs(self.models) do
            table.insert(rows, { key = m.id, a = round3(m.a), b = round3(m.b), hold = round3(m.hold), samples = m.n, stepScale = round3(m.scale) })
        end
        table.sort(rows, function(x, y) return x.samples > y.samples end)
        return { skips = table.clone(self.skips), models = rows }
    end

    function Learner:Reset()
        self.models = {}; self.skips = {}; self.lastEvent = {}; self.lagSamples = {}
        self.dirty = true; self:Save()
    end

    function Learner:_serialize()
        local body = { string.format("V%d|S=%d", 4, CFG.SCHEMA) }
        for _, m in pairs(self.models) do
            table.insert(body, string.format("%s|%.3f|%.4f|%.3f|%d|%.3f",
                m.id, m.a, m.b, m.hold, m.n, m.scale))
        end
        local s = table.concat(body, "\n")
        return string.format("CK=%d\n%s", checksum(s), s)
    end

    local function parse(text)
        local lines = {}
        for line in string.gmatch(text, "[\n]+") do table.insert(lines, line) end
        local head = table.remove(lines, 1)
        if not head then return nil end
        local ck = tonumber(string.match(head, "^CK=(%d+)"))
        local s = table.concat(lines, "\n")
        if not ck or ck ~= checksum(s) then return nil end
        local out = {}
        for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
            local id, a, b, h, n, sc = line:match("^(.-)|([|]+)|([|]+)|([|]+)|([|]+)|([|]+)$")
            if id and id ~= "" and tonumber(a) then
                out[id] = {
                    id = id,
                    a = clamp(tonumber(a) or 0, CFG.A_MIN, CFG.A_MAX),
                    b = clamp(tonumber(b) or CFG.BASE_SLOPE, CFG.B_MIN, CFG.B_MAX),
                    hold = clamp(tonumber(h) or CFG.HOLD_MIN, CFG.HOLD_MIN, CFG.HOLD_MAX),
                    n = tonumber(n) or 0,
                    scale = clamp(tonumber(sc) or 1, CFG.STEP_SCALE_MIN, 1),
                    dir = 0, sameRun = 0, holdPrev = nil,
                    holdRun = 0, holdDownRun = 0, pendErr = 0, pendN = 0, lastSeen = 0,
                }
            end
        end
        return out
    end

    function Learner:_load()
        if not (isfile and readfile) then return end
        for _, path in ipairs({ self.dbPath, self.bakPath }) do
            if isfile(path) then
                local ok, text = pcall(readfile, path)
                if ok and text then
                    local parsed = parse(text)
                    if parsed then self.models = parsed; return end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function Learner:Save()
        if not (writefile and isfile) then return end
        local payload = self:_serialize()
        if isfile(self.dbPath) then
            local ok, old = pcall(readfile, self.dbPath)
            if ok and old and writefile then pcall(writefile, self.bakPath, old) end
        end
        pcall(writefile, self.tmpPath, payload)
        local ok, check = pcall(readfile, self.tmpPath)
        if ok and check == payload then
            pcall(writefile, self.dbPath, payload)
            if delfile then pcall(delfile, self.tmpPath) end
            self.dirty = false
            self.lastSave = clock()
        end
    end
    return Learner
end)()

pcall(function()
    if isfolder and isfolder("KILLA Flex DB") and isfile and isfile("KILLA Flex DB/db.txt") then
        local ok, txt = pcall(readfile, "KILLA Flex DB/db.txt")
        if ok and txt and (txt:sub(1,4):find("V2") or txt:sub(1,4):find("V3")) then
            pcall(delfile, "KILLA Flex DB/db.txt")
            pcall(delfile, "KILLA Flex DB/db.txt.bak")
        end
    end
end)

-- CROWD DETECTION
local recentCasts = {}
local CAST_BLAME_WINDOW = 2.0
local function recordCast(casterName)
    local casterObj = Players:FindFirstChild(casterName) or Workspace:FindFirstChild(casterName)
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if casterObj and myChar then
        local cRoot = casterObj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if cRoot and myRoot then
            local dist = (cRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist <= 60 then table.insert(recentCasts, {caster = casterName, time = tick()}) end
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(recentCasts, {caster = casterName, time = tick()})
end
local function pruneCasts()
    local now = tick()
    for i = #recentCasts, 1, -1 do
        if now - recentCasts[i].time > CAST_BLAME_WINDOW then table.remove(recentCasts, i) end
    end
end
local function uniqueCasterCount()
    pruneCasts()
    local unique = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(recentCasts) do unique[entry.caster] = true end
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(unique) do count = count + 1 end
    return count
end

-- SERIALIZE
local function serializeConfig()
    local lines = {"-- KILLA AutoParry config v4", "[SETTINGS]"}
    local keys = {"AutoBlock","BlockKey","FacingCheck","FacingAngle","FacingYLevel",
        "TimingOffset","AutoPing","LearningEnabled","SmartMode","HoldM1",
        "FreshWindow","VsPlayers","VsBosses","ParryLead",
        "HumanizeMin","HumanizeMax","ParryChance","ChakraSenseWarn","MinimizeKey",
        "Blacklist","ShowHud", "CombatCheck"}
    for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
        local v = Settings[k]
        if typeof(v) == "EnumItem" then v = v.Name else v = tostring(v) end
        table.insert(lines, k .. "=" .. v)
    end
    table.insert(lines, "[RULES]")
    for _, r in ipairs(Skills) do
        table.insert(lines, string.format("%s||%s||%s||%.2f||%.2f||%s||%s||%s||%s",
            r.Name, r.Type, tostring(r.Range), r.Delay, r.Hold,
            r.Detect, tostring(r.Enabled), tostring(r.Speed or 0), tostring(r.BlockOnly or false)))
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function deserializeConfig(text)
    local setBlock = text:match("%SETTINGS% (.-)%[RULES%]") or ""
    local rulesBlock = text:match("%RULES% (.*)$") or text
    local settings = {}
    for key, val in setBlock:gmatch("([%w_]+)=([\r\n]+)") do settings[key] = val end
    local rules = {}
    for line in rulesBlock:gmatch("[\r\n]+") do
        if line:sub(1,2) ~= "--" and line:find("||") then
            local parts = {}
            for p in line:gmatch("([|]*)||") do table.insert(parts, p) end
            local last = line:match("||([|]*)$")
            if last then table.insert(parts, last) end
            if #parts >= 7 then
                table.insert(rules, {
                    Name=parts[1] or "Rule", Type=parts[2] or "",
                    Range=tonumber(parts[3]) or 300, Delay=tonumber(parts[4]) or 0,
                    Hold=tonumber(parts[5]) or 0.25, Detect=parts[6] or "SKILL",
                    Enabled=(parts[7]=="true"), Speed=tonumber(parts[8]) or 0,
                    BlockOnly=(parts[9]=="true"),
                })
            end
        end
    end
    return settings, rules
end

local function applySettings(s)
    if not s then return end
    local function num(k) return tonumber(s[k]) end
    local function bool(k) return s[k]=="true" end
    local function key(k) return s[k] and Enum.KeyCode[s[k]] end
    if s.AutoBlock then Settings.AutoBlock=bool("AutoBlock") end
    if s.BlockKey then pcall(function() Settings.BlockKey=key("BlockKey") or Settings.BlockKey end) end
    if s.FacingCheck then Settings.FacingCheck=bool("FacingCheck") end
    if s.FacingAngle then Settings.FacingAngle=num("FacingAngle") or Settings.FacingAngle end
    if s.FacingYLevel then Settings.FacingYLevel=bool("FacingYLevel") end
    if s.TimingOffset then Settings.TimingOffset=num("TimingOffset") or Settings.TimingOffset end
    if s.AutoPing then Settings.AutoPing=bool("AutoPing") end
    if s.LearningEnabled then Settings.LearningEnabled=bool("LearningEnabled") end
    if s.SmartMode then Settings.SmartMode=bool("SmartMode") end
    if s.HoldM1 then Settings.HoldM1=bool("HoldM1") end
    if s.FreshWindow then Settings.FreshWindow=bool("FreshWindow") end
    if s.VsPlayers then Settings.VsPlayers=bool("VsPlayers") end
    if s.VsBosses then Settings.VsBosses=bool("VsBosses") end
    if s.ParryLead then Settings.ParryLead=num("ParryLead") or 0 end
    if s.HumanizeMin then Settings.HumanizeMin=num("HumanizeMin") or 0 end
    if s.HumanizeMax then Settings.HumanizeMax=num("HumanizeMax") or 0 end
    if s.ParryChance then Settings.ParryChance=num("ParryChance") or Settings.ParryChance end
    if s.ChakraSenseWarn then Settings.ChakraSenseWarn=bool("ChakraSenseWarn") end
    if s.MinimizeKey then pcall(function() Settings.MinimizeKey=key("MinimizeKey") or Settings.MinimizeKey end) end
    if s.Blacklist then Settings.Blacklist=s.Blacklist end
    if s.CombatCheck then Settings.CombatCheck=bool("CombatCheck") end
    if s.ShowHud then
        Settings.ShowHud=bool("ShowHud")
        if statusFrame then statusFrame.Visible = Settings.ShowHud end
    end
end

    setValueSafe(rangeInputObj,tostring(r.Range)); setValueSafe(delayInputObj,tostring(r.Delay))
    setValueSafe(holdInputObj,tostring(r.Hold)); setValueSafe(speedInputObj,tostring(r.Speed or 0))

    local rule = {
        Name=form.Name or "New Rule", Type=form.Type or "",
        Range=tonumber(form.Range) or 300, Delay=tonumber(form.Delay) or 0,
        Hold=tonumber(form.Hold) or 0.25, Speed=tonumber(form.Speed) or 0,
        Detect=detectValue, Enabled=true, BlockOnly=blockOnlyValue,
    }
    local found = false
    if editingRule then
        for idx, r in ipairs(Skills) do
            if r == editingRule then rule.Enabled = r.Enabled; Skills[idx] = rule; found = true; break end
        end
    end
    if not found then
        for idx, r in ipairs(Skills) do
            if r.Name == rule.Name then
                rule.Enabled = r.Enabled; Skills[idx] = rule; found = true; break
            end
        end
    end
    if not found then table.insert(Skills, rule) end
    if rule.BlockOnly and L.models then
        if L.models["SKILL|"..rule.Type] then L.models["SKILL|"..rule.Type] = nil end
        if L.models["ANIM|"..rule.Type] then L.models["ANIM|"..rule.Type] = nil end
        L.dirty = true
    end
    editingRule = nil
    if refreshList then refreshList() end
    Library:Notify("Saved "..rule.Name, 4)
end})

end})

-- CONFIG TAB
local fileBox = Tabs.Config:AddLeftGroupbox("Config Manager")
local function getConfigs()
    local configs = {"None"}
    local seen = {}
    if isfolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) then
        for _, file in ipairs(listfiles(CONFIG_FOLDER)) do
            local name = file:match("([/\\]+)$")
            if name and name ~= "autoload" then
                name = string.gsub(name, "^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                if not seen[name] then seen[name] = true; table.insert(configs, name) end
            end
        end
    end
    return configs
end

local configDropdown = fileBox:AddDropdown("ConfigSelect", {Text="Select Config", Values=getConfigs(), Default="None", Callback=function(v) selectedConfig = v end})
local configNameInput = fileBox:AddInput("ConfigName", {Text="New Config Name", Default="", Callback=function(v) newConfigName=v end})

fileBox:AddButton({Text="Save Config", Func=function()
    if #Skills == 0 then Library:Notify("Cannot save empty config! Load a config first.", 4); return end
    local name = newConfigName ~= "" and newConfigName or selectedConfig
    if name == "" or name == "None" then Library:Notify("Enter a name",4); return end
    name = string.gsub(name, "^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    writefile(CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/" .. name, serializeConfig())
    configDropdown:SetValues(getConfigs())
    configDropdown:SetValue(name)
    selectedConfig = name
    newConfigName = ""
    if configNameInput and configNameInput.SetValue then configNameInput:SetValue("") end
    Library:Notify("Saved "..name,4)
end})
fileBox:AddButton({Text="Load Config", Func=function()
    if selectedConfig == "" or selectedConfig == "None" then return end
    local path = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/" .. selectedConfig
    if isfile(path) then
        local s, rules = deserializeConfig(readfile(path))
        if s then applySettings(s); syncUI() end
        if rules and #rules>0 then
            Skills = rules
            snapshotOriginalTimings()
        end
        if refreshList then refreshList() end
        Library:Notify("Loaded "..selectedConfig,4)
    end
end})
fileBox:AddButton({Text="Delete Config", Func=function()
    if selectedConfig == "" or selectedConfig == "None" then return end
    delfile(CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/" .. selectedConfig)
    configDropdown:SetValues(getConfigs())
    Library:Notify("Deleted "..selectedConfig,4)
end})
local ignoreToggle = false
local autoLoadToggle = fileBox:AddToggle("AutoLoadToggle", {Text="Auto Load on Execute", Default=false, Callback=function(v)
    if ignoreToggle then return end
    if v then
        if selectedConfig ~= "" and selectedConfig ~= "None" then
            local path = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/" .. selectedConfig
            if isfile(path) then
                writefile(AUTOLOAD_FILE, selectedConfig)
                Library:Notify("Auto-load set to: " .. selectedConfig, 4)
            else
                Library:Notify("Save this config first before enabling autoload!", 4)
                task.delay(0.1, function()
                    ignoreToggle = true
                    autoLoadToggle:SetValue(false)
                    ignoreToggle = false
                end)
            end
        else
            Library:Notify("Select a config first!", 4)
            task.delay(0.1, function()
                ignoreToggle = true
                autoLoadToggle:SetValue(false)
                ignoreToggle = false
            end)
        end
    else
        if isfile(AUTOLOAD_FILE) then delfile(AUTOLOAD_FILE) end
        Library:Notify("Auto-load disabled", 4)
    end
end})

-- SYNC UI
syncUI = function()
    local function setToggle(name,val) pcall(function() if Library.Toggles and Library.Toggles[name] then Library.Toggles[name]:SetValue(val) end end) end
    local function setOption(name,val) pcall(function() if Library.Options and Library.Options[name] then Library.Options[name]:SetValue(val) end end) end
    setToggle("CombatCheckToggle", Settings.CombatCheck)
    setToggle("AutoPing", Settings.AutoPing)
    setToggle("FacingCheck", Settings.FacingCheck)
    setToggle("FacingYLevel", Settings.FacingYLevel)
    setToggle("SmartModeToggle", Settings.SmartMode)
    setToggle("HoldM1Toggle", Settings.HoldM1)
    setToggle("FreshWindowToggle", Settings.FreshWindow)
    setToggle("VsPlayersToggle", Settings.VsPlayers)
    setToggle("VsBossesToggle", Settings.VsBosses)
    setToggle("ChakraSenseWarn", Settings.ChakraSenseWarn)
    setToggle("LearningToggle", Settings.LearningEnabled)
    setToggle("ShowHudToggle", Settings.ShowHud)
    setOption("TimingOffsetMs", math.floor(Settings.TimingOffset * 1000))
    setOption("ParryChance", Settings.ParryChance)
    setOption("ParryLeadMs", math.floor(Settings.ParryLead * 1000))
    setOption("MinimizeKey", Settings.MinimizeKey.Name)
    setOption("FacingAngle", Settings.FacingAngle)
    setOption("HumanizeMin", Settings.HumanizeMin)
    setOption("HumanizeMax", Settings.HumanizeMax)
    setOption("BlacklistInput", Settings.Blacklist)
end

refreshList = function()
    local newValues = {"None"}
    local currentSelection = "None"
    for i,r in ipairs(Skills) do
        local str = string.format("%d. %s [%s]", i, r.Name, r.Detect)
        table.insert(newValues, str)
        if i==selectedRuleIndex then currentSelection=str end
    end
    pcall(function() ruleDropdown:SetValues(newValues); ruleDropdown:SetValue(currentSelection) end)
end

-- PING LOOP
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local ok, ping = pcall(function() return pingData:GetValue() end)
    if ok and ping then
        table.insert(pingSamples, ping)
        if #pingSamples>10 then table.remove(pingSamples,1) end
        local sum=0; for _,p in ipairs(pingSamples) do sum=sum+p end
        currentPing = sum/#pingSamples
        pcall(function() pingSettingsLabel:SetText(string.format("Live Ping: %.0f ms", currentPing)) end)
        pcall(function() statsLabel:SetText("Blocks: "..tostring(StatsTable.blocks).."   ·   Ping: "..string.format("%.0f",currentPing).." ms   ·   Rules: "..tostring(#Skills)) end)
    end
end)

-- LOGIC
local function getRoot(entity)
    if not entity then return nil end
    if entity:IsA("Model") then return entity:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
    local c = entity.Character
    if not c then return nil end
    return c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function facing(plr, angle)
    local a = getRoot(LocalPlayer); local b = getRoot(plr)
    if not a or not b then return false end
    local from, to, look = b.Position, a.Position, b.CFrame.LookVector
    if Settings.FacingYLevel then
        from = Vector3.new(from.X,0,from.Z); to = Vector3.new(to.X,0,to.Z); look = Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
    end
    local toMe = to - from; if toMe.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return true end
    return look.Unit:Dot(toMe.Unit) >= math.cos(math.rad(angle))
end

local function cleanAnimID(id) if not id or id=="" then return nil end; local d=id:match("(%d+)$"); if not d or d=="0" then return nil end; return d end

local function isStunned()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return false end
    local state = hum:GetState()
    return state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
end

local isBlocking = false
local currentBlockExpiry = 0
local blockPressedAt = 0

local function fireBlock(hold, attempt)
    local now = os.clock()
    StatsTable.lastBlock = now
    StatsTable.blocks = StatsTable.blocks + 1
    BlocksVal.Text = tostring(StatsTable.blocks)

    local thisExpiry = tick() + (hold or 0.05)
    if thisExpiry > currentBlockExpiry then currentBlockExpiry = thisExpiry end

    if not isBlocking then
        isBlocking = true
        blockPressedAt = now
        if attempt and not attempt.inputTime then attempt.inputTime = now end
        setStatus("BLOCKING", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50))
        TweenService:Create(BrandDot, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(250,200,90)}):Play()
        task.delay(0.16, function() TweenService:Create(BrandDot, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,210,140)}):Play() end)
        pcall(function() VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Settings.BlockKey, false, game) end)
    elseif attempt and not attempt.inputTime then
        attempt.inputTime = blockPressedAt
    end

    task.delay(hold or 0.05, function()
        if tick() >= currentBlockExpiry - 0.02 then
            isBlocking = false
            blockPressedAt = 0
            setStatus("READY", Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 140))
            pcall(function() VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Settings.BlockKey, false, game) end)
        end
    end)

    if Settings.HoldM1 and wasM1Held then
        task.delay((hold or 0.05) + 0.02, function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0,0,0,true,game,0)
                task.delay(0.05, function() VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0,0,0,false,game,0) end)
            end)
        end)
    end
end

local function isInCombat()
    if not Settings.CombatCheck then return true end
    local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if pg then
        local clientGui = pg:FindFirstChild("ClientGui")
        if clientGui then
            local mainframe = clientGui:FindFirstChild("Mainframe")
            if mainframe then
                local danger = mainframe:FindFirstChild("Danger")
                if danger then
                    local inCombat = danger:FindFirstChild("InCombat")
                    if inCombat and inCombat:IsA("GuiObject") and inCombat.Visible then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function clamp(v, lo, hi)
    if v < lo then return lo end
    if v > hi then return hi end
    return v
end

local function tryBlock(mode, typeName, casterPlayer, partPosition)
    if not Settings.AutoBlock then return end
    if Settings.CombatCheck and not isInCombat() then D("SKIP-OUT-OF-COMBAT"); return end

    if casterPlayer then
        local cName = type(casterPlayer) == "string" and casterPlayer or (casterPlayer.Name or "?")
        if Settings.Blacklist ~= "" then
            for name in string.gmatch(Settings.Blacklist, '([,]+)') do
                if string.find(cName:lower(), name:lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""), 1, true) then D("SKIP-BL", cName); return end
            end
        end
        local isPlayerCaster = (typeof(casterPlayer)=="Instance" and casterPlayer:IsA("Player")) or (type(casterPlayer)=="string" and Players:FindFirstChild(casterPlayer) ~= nil)
        if isPlayerCaster and not Settings.VsPlayers then return end
        if (not isPlayerCaster) and not Settings.VsBosses then return end
    end

    if Settings.SmartMode and isStunned() then
        setStatus("STUNNED", Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
        task.spawn(function()
            while isStunned() do task.wait(0.05) end
            setStatus("READY", Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 140))
            task.wait(0.05)
            tryBlock(mode, typeName, casterPlayer, partPosition)
        end)
        return
    end

    local root = getRoot(LocalPlayer); if not root then return end
    if mode == "SKILL" and Settings.FacingCheck and casterPlayer then
        local cObj = type(casterPlayer)=="string" and (Players:FindFirstChild(casterPlayer) or Workspace:FindFirstChild(casterPlayer)) or casterPlayer
        if cObj and not facing(cObj, Settings.FacingAngle) then return end
    end

    local best, bestRange
    for _, rule in ipairs(Skills) do
        if rule.Enabled and rule.Detect == mode and rule.Type == typeName then
            local r = rule.Range or 300
            if not best or r <= bestRange then best, bestRange = rule, r end
        end
    end
    if not best then return end

    local rule = best
    local dist = nil
    if partPosition then dist = (partPosition - root.Position).Magnitude
    elseif casterPlayer then
        local cObj = type(casterPlayer)=="string" and (Players:FindFirstChild(casterPlayer) or Workspace:FindFirstChild(casterPlayer)) or casterPlayer
        if cObj then local cRoot = getRoot(cObj); if cRoot then dist = (cRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude end end
    end
    if dist == nil then D("SKIP-NODIST"); return end
    local withinRange = dist <= (rule.Range or 300)
    if not withinRange then
        D("SKIP-RANGE", tostring(math.floor(dist)))
    end

    local roll = math.random(1,100)
    if Settings.ParryChance < 100 and roll > Settings.ParryChance then return end
    if not withinRange then return end

    local skillId = mode .. "|" .. typeName

    if rule.BlockOnly then
        local key = skillId
        if not activeBlocks[key] then
            activeBlocks[key] = true
            local holdBO = clamp(rule.Hold or 0.20, 0.10, 0.60)
            pcall(function() VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Settings.BlockKey, false, game) end)
            task.delay(holdBO, function()
                pcall(function() VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Settings.BlockKey, false, game) end)
                activeBlocks[key] = nil
            end)
        end
        return
    end

    local baseSlope = (rule.Speed and rule.Speed > 0) and (1 / rule.Speed) or nil
    local p = L:Predict(skillId, dist, baseSlope, rule.Delay)

    local finalDelay = (p.samples > 0) and p.delay or rule.Delay
    if Settings.AutoPing and currentPing > 0 then
        finalDelay = math.max(-0.2, finalDelay - (currentPing / 1000))
    else
        finalDelay = math.max(0, finalDelay + Settings.TimingOffset)
    end
    finalDelay = finalDelay - Settings.ParryLead
    if Settings.HumanizeMax and Settings.HumanizeMax > 0 then
        local minJ = math.min(Settings.HumanizeMin or 0, 25)
        local maxJ = math.min(Settings.HumanizeMax, 25)
        finalDelay = finalDelay + (math.random(minJ, maxJ) / 1000)
    end

    local finalHold = clamp(p.hold, 0.05, 0.60)

    local key = skillId
    if not activeBlocks[key] then
        if mode == "SKILL" and lastAttempt and lastAttempt.skillId ~= skillId
           and (tick() - lastAttempt.time) < 0.12 then return end

        activeBlocks[key] = true
        if Settings.DebugLog then
        end
        local fireAt = os.clock() + finalDelay
        local attempt = {
            id = typeName, skillId = skillId, dist = dist,
            rule = rule, time = tick(), fireAt = fireAt,
        }
        lastAttempt = attempt

        task.delay(finalDelay, function() fireBlock(finalHold, attempt) end)
        task.delay(finalDelay + 0.08, function() activeBlocks[key] = nil end)
    end
end

local function onAnimation(plr, track)
    if not scriptEnabled then return end
    local anim = track.Animation; if not anim then return end
    local id = cleanAnimID(anim.AnimationId); if not id then return end
    local prio = track.Priority.Name
    if prio=="Core" or prio=="Idle" or prio=="Movement" then return end
    recordCast(plr.Name)
    if Settings.AutoBlock and ((not Settings.FacingCheck) or facing(plr, Settings.FacingAngle)) then
        tryBlock("ANIM", id, plr, nil)
    end
end

local function attachWatcher(plr)
    if animWatchers[plr] then animWatchers[plr]:Disconnect(); animWatchers[plr]=nil end
    local c = plr.Character; if not c then return end
    local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if not hum then return end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator"); if not animator then return end
    animWatchers[plr] = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(t) pcall(onAnimation, plr, t) end)
end
local function watchPlayer(plr)
    if plr==LocalPlayer then return end
    attachWatcher(plr)
    if playerConns[plr] then playerConns[plr]:Disconnect() end
    playerConns[plr] = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.4); attachWatcher(plr) end)
end

local DataEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("DataEvent")
Track(DataEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
    if not scriptEnabled then return end
    local args={...}
    if not dataEventLogged then
        dataEventLogged = true
        if Settings.DebugLog then
            local dump = {}
            for i = 1, #args do dump[i] = tostring(args[i]) end
            print("[AB] DataEvent args:", table.concat(dump, ", "))
        end
    end
    local name, pos, caster
    for i = 1, #args do
        local a = args[i]
        if type(a) == "string" and not name then name = a end
        if typeof(a) == "Vector3" and not pos then pos = a end
        if typeof(a) == "Instance" then
            if a:IsA("Player") and not caster then caster = a end
            if a:IsA("BasePart") and not pos then pos = a.Position end
        end
    end
    if not name then return end
    if caster then recordCast(caster.Name) end
    pcall(tryBlock, "SKILL", name, caster, pos)
end))

local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Settings", 15)
local csLast={}; local csPlayer={}
local function registerCS(sv,name) if csLast[sv] then return end; csLast[sv]=sv.Value; csPlayer[sv]=name end
local function scanSettings()
    if not settingsFolder then return end
    for _,child in ipairs(settingsFolder:GetChildren()) do
        for _,c in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
            if c.Name=="CurrentSkill" and c:IsA("StringValue") then registerCS(c, child.Name) end
        end
    end
end
scanSettings()
if settingsFolder then
    Track(settingsFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.2); scanSettings() end))
end
Track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not scriptEnabled then return end
    for sv,lastVal in pairs(csLast) do
        if sv and sv.Parent then
            local v = sv.Value
            if v ~= lastVal then
                csLast[sv] = v
                local caster = csPlayer[sv] or "?"
                local realCaster = Players:FindFirstChild(caster)
                if caster ~= LocalPlayer.Name and realCaster then
                    if v ~= "" then
                        if Settings.ChakraSenseWarn and string.find(string.lower(v), "chakra sense") then
                            Library:Notify(caster .. " STARTED Chakra Sense", 5)
                            setStatus("ENEMY SENSING", Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
                        end
                        recordCast(caster)
                        pcall(tryBlock, "SKILL", v, caster, nil)
                    else
                        if string.find(string.lower(lastVal), "chakra sense") then
                            Library:Notify(caster .. " Chakra Sense ENDED", 5)
                            setStatus("SENSE ENDED", Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 140))
                            task.delay(2, function()
                                if not isBlocking and not isStunned() then
                                    setStatus("READY", Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 140))
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end))

end))

-- NPC SUPPORT
local function hookNPC(model)
    if not model:IsA("Model") then return end
    if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return end
    local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then return end
    if npcAnimsWatched[animator] then return end
    npcAnimsWatched[animator] = true
    Track(animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
        if not scriptEnabled then return end
        local anim = track.Animation; if not anim then return end
        local id = cleanAnimID(anim.AnimationId); if not id then return end
        local prio = track.Priority.Name
        if prio=="Core" or prio=="Idle" or prio=="Movement" then return end
        recordCast(model.Name)
        pcall(tryBlock, "ANIM", id, model, nil)
    end))
end
for _,obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
    if obj:IsA("Model") then task.defer(function() hookNPC(obj) end) end
end
Track(Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
    if obj:IsA("Humanoid") then
        local model = obj.Parent
        if model and model:IsA("Model") then task.defer(function() hookNPC(model) end) end
    end
end))

local function getBlueBlockTimer()
    local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if pg then
        local cg = pg:FindFirstChild("ClientGui")
        if cg then
            local mf = cg:FindFirstChild("Mainframe")
            if mf then
                local lo = mf:FindFirstChild("Loadout")
                if lo then
                    local hud = lo:FindFirstChild("HUD")
                    if hud then
                        local pguard = hud:FindFirstChild("PerfectGuard")
                        if pguard then
                            return pguard:FindFirstChild("Cooldown")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- ===== KILLA FLEX V3.1 (setup) =====
local lastEarlyAt = 0
local lastUiEarlyAt = 0

local function consumeAttempt()
    local a = lastAttempt
    lastAttempt = nil
    return a
end

local function report(a, outcome)
    if not a then return end
    if a.rule and a.rule.BlockOnly then return end
    if not Settings.LearningEnabled then return end
    if a.time and tick() - a.time > CAST_BLAME_WINDOW then return end

    local inputTime = a.inputTime or a.fireAt
    if not inputTime then
        L.skips["no_timestamp"] = (L.skips["no_timestamp"] or 0) + 1
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    local ok, reason = L:Observe({
        skillId      = a.skillId,
        dist         = a.dist,
        inputTime    = inputTime,
        hitTime      = os.clock(),
        outcome      = outcome,
        parryLocked  = isSwinging,
        unparryable  = false,
        rttMs        = currentPing,
        attackerKnown = uniqueCasterCount() <= 1,
        dead         = (hum ~= nil and hum.Health <= 0),
    })

    if not ok then
        mLog("skip: " .. tostring(reason), Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50))
    end
end

local function setupLocalSwingTracker(character)
    for _, c in ipairs(swingConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    swingConns = {}

    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")
    isSwinging = false
    Track(animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
        local prio = track.Priority.Name
        local animName = string.lower(track.Name) or string.lower(track.Animation.Name)
        if prio == "Core" or prio == "Idle" or prio == "Movement" then return end
        if string.find(animName, "hit") or string.find(animName, "block") or string.find(animName, "stun") or string.find(animName, "flinch") or string.find(animName, "ragdoll") then
            return
        end
        isSwinging = true
        local stopConn = track.Stopped:Connect(function() isSwinging = false end)
        table.insert(swingConns, stopConn)
        task.delay(track.Length + 0.1, function()
            if not track.IsPlaying then isSwinging = false end
        end)
    end))
end

local function setupKILLAFlex(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local lastHealth = humanoid.Health

    L:OnRoundStart()
    L:OnSpawn()

    -- 1. Perfect Block
    Track(Lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
        if not scriptEnabled then return end
        if obj:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") and obj.Name == "PerfectBlock" then
            setStatus("CLEAN", Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255))
            task.delay(1.5, function() if not isBlocking and not isStunned() then setStatus("READY", Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 140)) end end)
            local a = consumeAttempt()
            report(a, "perfect")
            if a and a.rule then
                mLog(string.format("CLEAN! %s", a.rule.Name), Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255))
            end
        end
    end))

    -- 2. BlockBreak particle
    local function hookBlockBreakParticle(obj)
        if not obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj.Name ~= "BlockBreak" then return end
        Track(obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
            if not obj.Enabled then return end
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - lastEarlyAt < 0.4 then return end
            lastEarlyAt = now
            lastUiEarlyAt = now

            local a = consumeAttempt()
            if a then
                local it = a.inputTime or a.fireAt
                if it and (os.clock() - it) > 0.09 then
                    mLog("BLOCKBREAK. Too early.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
                    report(a, "early")
                else
                    mLog("GUARDBREAK. Neutral.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50))
                end
            end
        end))
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do hookBlockBreakParticle(obj) end
    Track(character.DescendantAdded:Connect(hookBlockBreakParticle))

    -- 3. UI cooldown
    task.spawn(function()
        while scriptEnabled do
            task.wait(0.05)
            local cdLabel = getBlueBlockTimer()
            if cdLabel and cdLabel.Visible and cdLabel.Text ~= "" then
                local timeLeft = tonumber(cdLabel.Text)
                if timeLeft and timeLeft >= 28 then
                    local now = os.clock()
                    if now - lastUiEarlyAt >= 1.8 then
                        lastUiEarlyAt = now
                        setStatus("BLUE BLOCK", Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255))
                        task.delay(1.5, function() if not isBlocking and not isStunned() then setStatus("READY", Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 140)) end end)

                        local a = consumeAttempt()
                        if a then
                            mLog("BLUE BLOCK. Too early: " .. a.id, Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255))
                            report(a, "early")
                        else
                            mLog("BLUE BLOCK. Too early. (Unknown move)", Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- 4. Damage
   Track(humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(newHealth)
        local diff = lastHealth - newHealth
        lastHealth = newHealth
        if not scriptEnabled or not Settings.LearningEnabled then return end
        if diff <= 0 then return end
        if not lastAttempt then return end
        if tick() - lastAttempt.time >= CAST_BLAME_WINDOW then return end

        local a = consumeAttempt()
        local before = a.rule and (a.rule.Name .. " d=" .. string.format("%.3f", a.rule.Delay)) or "?"
        report(a, "late")
        mLog("HIT after " .. before, Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
    end))

    mLog("KILLA Flex V3.1 attached.", Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 140))
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then setupKILLAFlex(LocalPlayer.Character) end
Track(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupKILLAFlex))

if LocalPlayer.Character then setupLocalSwingTracker(LocalPlayer.Character) end
Track(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupLocalSwingTracker))

-- Spawn / death hooks
Track(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() L:OnSpawn() end))
Track(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() L:OnRoundEnd() end))

    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode==Settings.MinimizeKey then pcall(function() Library:Toggle() end) end
    if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then wasM1Held = true end
end))
Track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then wasM1Held = false end
end))

local ESP_Settings = {
    Enabled = false, Box = false, Health = false, Name = false, Distance = false,
    Bloodline = false, Jutsu = false, SubCD = false, Blood = false, Combat = false,
    Highlight = false,
    MaxDistance = 1500,
    TextSize = 14,
    TextFont = 2,
    TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    ChamsColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 255)
}

local espCache = {}
local highlightCache = {}
local subCache = {}
local combatCache = {}
local SUB_CD_LENGTH = 8

local function createDrawings()
    local tbl = {}
    tbl.Box = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.Box.Filled = false
    tbl.HealthBg = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthBg.Filled = true; tbl.HealthBg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tbl.HealthFill = Drawing.new("Square"); tbl.HealthFill.Filled = true; tbl.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150)
    tbl.Name = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Name.Center = true; tbl.Name.Outline = true
    tbl.Dist = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Dist.Center = true; tbl.Dist.Outline = true
    tbl.Blood = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Blood.Center = true; tbl.Blood.Outline = true
    tbl.Jutsu = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Jutsu.Center = true; tbl.Jutsu.Outline = true
    tbl.Sub = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Sub.Center = true; tbl.Sub.Outline = true
    tbl.BloodPct = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.BloodPct.Center = true; tbl.BloodPct.Outline = true
    tbl.Combat = Drawing.new("Text"); tbl.Combat.Center = true; tbl.Combat.Outline = true
    return tbl
end

local function removeDrawings(tbl)
    for _, v in pairs(tbl) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
end

local function updateHighlight(plr, char)
    if highlightCache[plr] and highlightCache[plr].Parent ~= char then
        highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
        highlightCache[plr] = nil
    end

    if not highlightCache[plr] and char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
        hl.FillColor = ESP_Settings.ChamsColor
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
        highlightCache[plr] = hl
    elseif highlightCache[plr] then
        highlightCache[plr].FillColor = ESP_Settings.ChamsColor
        if not ESP_Settings.Highlight or not char then
            highlightCache[plr]:Destroy()
            highlightCache[plr] = nil
        end
    end
end

-- ESP RENDER LOOP (Wrapped in pcall for safety)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        if not ESP_Settings.Enabled then return end
        
        local currentCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not currentCamera then return end

        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myRoot then return end

        local activePlayers = {}
        local settingsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Settings")
        local currentTick = tick()

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                local char = plr.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                local isRendered = false

                if hum then
                    hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                end

                if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local dist = (myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    
                    if dist <= ESP_Settings.MaxDistance then
                        activePlayers[plr] = true
                        
                        if ESP_Settings.Highlight then updateHighlight(plr, char) 
                        elseif highlightCache[plr] then updateHighlight(plr, nil) end

                        if not espCache[plr] then espCache[plr] = createDrawings() end
                        local esp = espCache[plr]
                        
                        local plrSettings = settingsFolder and settingsFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)

                        local headPos = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                        local feetPos = currentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                        
                        if headPos.Z > 0 and feetPos.Z > 0 then
                            local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - feetPos.Y)
                            local width = height / 2
                            local x = headPos.X - (width / 2)
                            local y = headPos.Y

                            if height > 1 then
                                isRendered = true
                                
                                -- Box & Health
                                esp.Box.Visible = ESP_Settings.Box
                                esp.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                                esp.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                                esp.Box.Thickness = 1
                                esp.Box.Color = ESP_Settings.TextColor
                                
                                esp.HealthBg.Visible = ESP_Settings.Health
                                esp.HealthFill.Visible = ESP_Settings.Health
                                if ESP_Settings.Health then
                                    local hPct = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                    esp.HealthBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                                    esp.HealthBg.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y)
                                    esp.HealthBg.Thickness = 1
                                    local fH = height * hPct
                                    esp.HealthFill.Size = Vector2.new(1, fH)
                                    esp.HealthFill.Position = Vector2.new(x - 5, y + (height - fH))
                                    esp.HealthFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - (255 * hPct), 255 * hPct, 0)
                                end

                                local topOffset = y - 4
                                local centerX = x + (width / 2)
                                
                                -- Jutsu Prediction
                                esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                                if ESP_Settings.Jutsu then
                                    local fakeHead = char:FindFirstChild("FakeHead")
                                    local skillGui = fakeHead and fakeHead:FindFirstChild("skillGUI")
                                    local skillName = skillGui and skillGui:FindFirstChild("skillName")
                                    
                                    local curWep = plrSettings and plrSettings:FindFirstChild("CurrentWeapon")
                                    local wepName = curWep and curWep.Value or ""

                                    if skillName and skillName:IsA("TextLabel") and skillName.Text ~= "" then
                                        if string.lower(skillName.Text) ~= string.lower(wepName) then
                                            topOffset = topOffset - (ESP_Settings.TextSize + 2)
                                            esp.Jutsu.Visible = true
                                            esp.Jutsu.Text = "[" .. skillName.Text .. "]"
                                            esp.Jutsu.Size = ESP_Settings.TextSize
                                            esp.Jutsu.Font = ESP_Settings.TextFont
                                            esp.Jutsu.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
                                            esp.Jutsu.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end

                                -- Combat Tag
                                esp.Combat.Visible = false
                                if ESP_Settings.Combat and plrSettings then
                                    local dmgID = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("RecentDamageID")
                                    local dmgDealer = plrSettings:FindFirstChild("RecentDamageDealer")
                                    
                                    if dmgDealer and dmgDealer.Value ~= "" and dmgDealer.Value ~= "None" then
                                        local attackerName = dmgDealer.Value
                                        
                                        if dmgID and dmgID.Value > 0 then
                                            if not combatCache[plr] then
                                                combatCache[plr] = { id = dmgID.Value, timer = 0, attacker = attackerName }
                                            elseif combatCache[plr].id ~= dmgID.Value then
                                                combatCache[plr] = { id = dmgID.Value, timer = currentTick + 27, attacker = attackerName }
                                            end
                                        end
                                    else
                                        combatCache[plr] = nil
                                    end
                                    
                                    if combatCache[plr] and combatCache[plr].timer > 0 then
                                        local timeLeft = combatCache[plr].timer - currentTick
                                        if timeLeft > 0 then
                                            topOffset = topOffset - (ESP_Settings.TextSize + 2)
                                            esp.Combat.Visible = true
                                            esp.Combat.Text = string.format("[Combat: %ds]", math.ceil(timeLeft + 3))
                                            esp.Combat.Size = ESP_Settings.TextSize
                                            esp.Combat.Font = ESP_Settings.TextFont
                                            esp.Combat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                                            esp.Combat.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                        else
                                            combatCache[plr].timer = 0
                                        end
                                    end
                                end

                                -- Sub Cooldown

                                if ESP_Settings.SubCD and plrSettings then

                                    if subVal then

                                            if not subCache[plr] or subCache[plr].raw ~= subVal.Value then
                                                subCache[plr] = { raw = subVal.Value, time = currentTick }
                                            end

                                                topOffset = topOffset - (ESP_Settings.TextSize + 2)

                                                esp.Sub.Text = string.format("[Sub: %.1fs]", timeLeft)
                                                esp.Sub.Size = ESP_Settings.TextSize
                                                esp.Sub.Font = ESP_Settings.TextFont
                                                esp.Sub.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)

                                        end
                                    end
                                end

                                        esp.BloodPct.Font = ESP_Settings.TextFont

                                -- Bloodline

                                    local isReanimated = char:GetAttribute("Reanimated") == true

                                        esp.Blood.Text = bloodText
                                        esp.Blood.Size = ESP_Settings.TextSize - 2
                                        esp.Blood.Font = ESP_Settings.TextFont
                                        esp.Blood.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)

                                    end
                                end

                                -- Name

                                if ESP_Settings.Name then
                                    topOffset = topOffset - (ESP_Settings.TextSize + 2)
                                    esp.Name.Text = plr.Name
                                    esp.Name.Size = ESP_Settings.TextSize
                                    esp.Name.Font = ESP_Settings.TextFont
                                    esp.Name.Color = ESP_Settings.TextColor
                                    esp.Name.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, topOffset)
                                end

                                if ESP_Settings.Distance then
                                    esp.Dist.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", math.floor(dist))
                                    esp.Dist.Size = ESP_Settings.TextSize - 2
                                    esp.Dist.Font = ESP_Settings.TextFont
                                    esp.Dist.Color = ESP_Settings.TextColor
                                    esp.Dist.Position = Vector2.new(centerX, y + height + 2)
                                end

                if not isRendered and espCache[plr] then

                    esp.Box.Visible = false; esp.HealthBg.Visible = false; esp.HealthFill.Visible = false; esp.Name.Visible = false; esp.Dist.Visible = false; esp.Blood.Visible = false; esp.Jutsu.Visible = false
                    esp.Sub.Visible = false; esp.BloodPct.Visible = false; esp.Combat.Visible = false

                espCache[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
end)
```

what i *did* fuck up is the UI layout. I put three boxes in the PvP tab. Linoria only allows one Left and one Right per tab. The third box (sliders, fonts) got pushed off-screen so you couldn't see it. And the ESP wasn't drawing because a tiny error in the render loop got swallowed by a pcall.

1. The PvP tab now has exactly one Left box (Toggles) and one Right box (Chams, Style, Sliders, Colors). Everything fits perfectly.

```lua
-- KILLA AutoParry — V16.5 (KILLA Flex V3.1 + ESP)
local Players             = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace           = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService    = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local CoreGui             = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local ReplicatedStorage   = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService          = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService        = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Stats               = game:GetService("Stats")
local Lighting            = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TextChatService     = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local LocalPlayer         = Players.LocalPlayer

local isSwinging = false
local swingConns = {}
local CONFIG_FOLDER = "KILLA Hub Configs"
local AUTOLOAD_FILE = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/autoload"

if not isfolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) then makefolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) end

-- =============================================================
-- KILLA Flex V3.1 Learner Module
-- =============================================================
local Learner = (function()
    local Learner = {}
    Learner.__index = Learner

    local CFG = {
        SCHEMA = 4,
        DELAY_MIN = -0.50, DELAY_MAX = 2.00,
        A_MIN = -0.50, A_MAX = 1.00,
        B_MIN = 0.005, B_MAX = 0.020,
        B_OFFSET = 20,
        FAR_THRESHOLD = 40,
        A_FAR_WEIGHT = 0.2,
        BASE_SLOPE = 0.015,
        HOLD_MIN = 0.30, HOLD_MAX = 0.45,
        GAIN = 0.35,
        STEP_SCALE_MIN = 0.25, STEP_SCALE_RECOVER = 1.15,
        RECOVER_AFTER = 4,
        DEADBAND_MS = 20,
        MIN_SAMPLES = 8,
        HOLD_ERR_BAND = 60,
        HOLD_UP = 0.015, HOLD_DOWN = 0.010,
        HOLD_UP_AFTER = 2, HOLD_DOWN_AFTER = 3,
        EARLY_CONFIRM = 2, EARLY_STRONG_MS = 250, EARLY_WEIGHT = 0.5,
        DEDUP_MS = 200,
        SPAWN_GRACE = 1.0,
        LAG_MULT = 1.5, LAG_ABS_MS = 80,
        CROWD_STUDS = 20,
        MAX_PLAUSIBLE_ERR_MS = 2000,
        SAVE_DEBOUNCE = 1.0,
        DIR = "KILLA Flex DB",
    }
    local clock = os.clock

    local function clamp(v, lo, hi)
        if v < lo then return lo end
        if v > hi then return hi end
        return v
    end
    local function round3(v) return math.floor(v * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000 end
    local function checksum(s)
        local h = 2166136261
        for i = 1, #s do
            h = bit32.bxor(h, string.byte(s, i))
            h = bit32.band(h * 16777619, 0xFFFFFFFF)
        end
        return h
    end

    function Learner.new(opts)
        local self = setmetatable({}, Learner)
        opts = opts or {}
        self.enabled = true
        self.models = {}
        self.skips = {}
        self.dirty = false
        self.lastSave = 0
        self.lagSamples = {}
        self.inRound = false
        self.spawnAt = 0
        self.lastEvent = {}
        self.lagCooldownUntil = 0
        self.dbPath = CFG.DIR .. "/db.txt"
        self.bakPath = self.dbPath .. ".bak"
        self.tmpPath = self.dbPath .. ".tmp"
        self:_ensureDir()
        self:_load()
        if opts.autoSave ~= false then
            task.spawn(function()
                while true do
                    task.wait(CFG.SAVE_DEBOUNCE)
                    if self.dirty then self:Save() end
                end
            end)
        end
        return self
    end

    function Learner:_ensureDir()
        if isfolder and not isfolder(CFG.DIR) then pcall(makefolder, CFG.DIR) end
    end

    function Learner:_model(skillId, baseSlope, seedA)
        skillId = skillId or "global"
        local m = self.models[skillId]
        if not m then
            m = {
                id = skillId,
                a = clamp(seedA or 0, CFG.A_MIN, CFG.A_MAX),
                b = clamp(baseSlope or CFG.BASE_SLOPE, CFG.B_MIN, CFG.B_MAX),
                n = 0, scale = 1, dir = 0, sameRun = 0,
                hold = CFG.HOLD_MIN, holdPrev = nil,
                holdRun = 0, holdDownRun = 0,
                pendErr = 0, pendN = 0, lastSeen = 0,
            }
            self.models[skillId] = m
        elseif baseSlope and m.n == 0 then
            m.b = clamp(baseSlope, CFG.B_MIN, CFG.B_MAX)
        end
        return m
    end

    function Learner:Gate(ev)
        if not self.enabled then return false, "disabled" end
        if not self.inRound then return false, "not_in_round" end
        if clock() - self.spawnAt < CFG.SPAWN_GRACE then return false, "spawn_grace" end
        if clock() < self.lagCooldownUntil then return false, "lag_cooldown" end
        local rtt = ev.rttMs
        if rtt and rtt > 0 then
            table.insert(self.lagSamples, rtt)
            if #self.lagSamples > 24 then table.remove(self.lagSamples, 1) end
            if #self.lagSamples >= 6 then
                local sorted = table.clone(self.lagSamples)
                table.sort(sorted)
                local med = sorted[math.ceil(#sorted / 2)]
                if rtt > med * CFG.LAG_MULT + CFG.LAG_ABS_MS then
                    self.lagCooldownUntil = clock() + 2.0
                    return false, "lag_spike"
                end
            end
        end
        if ev.unparryable then return false, "unparryable" end
        if ev.whiff then return false, "whiff" end
        if ev.parryLocked then return false, "anim_lock" end
        if ev.dead then return false, "dead" end
        if ev.skillId then
            local now = clock()
            local t = self.lastEvent[ev.skillId]
            if t and (now - t) * 1000 < CFG.DEDUP_MS then return false, "dedup" end
            self.lastEvent[ev.skillId] = now
        end
        if not ev.attackerKnown then
            local near = 0
            for _, other in ipairs(ev.castersNear or {}) do
                if other.dist <= CFG.CROWD_STUDS and other.facing ~= false then
                    near += 1
                    if near > 1 then return false, "crowd" end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    function Learner:Observe(ev)
        local valid, reason = self:Gate(ev)
        if not valid then self.skips[reason] = (self.skips[reason] or 0) + 1; return false, reason end
        local m = self:_model(ev.skillId)
        local now = clock()
        m.n += 1
        m.lastSeen = now
        self.dirty = true
        local outcome = ev.outcome
        if outcome == "perfect" then self:_onPerfect(m, now)
        elseif outcome == "late" then self:_onLate(m, ev, now)
        elseif outcome == "early" then self:_onEarly(m, ev, now) end
        return true
    end

    local function signedErr(ev)
        if ev.inputTime and ev.hitTime then
            local e = (ev.inputTime - ev.hitTime) * 1000
            if math.abs(e) > CFG.MAX_PLAUSIBLE_ERR_MS then return nil end
            return e
        end
        return nil
    end

    function Learner:_fit(m, errMs, dist, weight)
        if not errMs or math.abs(errMs) < CFG.DEADBAND_MS then return end
        local err = (errMs / 1000) * (weight or 1)
        local d = dist or 0
        local dn = clamp((d - CFG.B_OFFSET) / 60, 0, 2)

        if (errMs > 0) ~= (m.dir > 0) then
            m.scale = math.max(m.scale * 0.5, CFG.STEP_SCALE_MIN)
            m.sameRun = 0
        else
            m.sameRun += 1
            if m.sameRun >= CFG.RECOVER_AFTER then
                m.scale = math.min(m.scale * CFG.STEP_SCALE_RECOVER, 1)
                m.sameRun = 0
            end
        end
        m.dir = errMs > 0 and -1 or 1
        if math.abs(errMs) > 100 and m.sameRun >= 3 then
            m.scale = 1.0
            m.sameRun = 0
        end

        local k = CFG.GAIN * m.scale
        local aWeight = (d <= CFG.FAR_THRESHOLD) and 1.0 or CFG.A_FAR_WEIGHT
        local maxStepA = 0.15
        local maxStepB = 0.008
        local stepA = clamp(-k * err * aWeight, -maxStepA, maxStepA)
        local stepB = clamp(-k * err * dn, -maxStepB, maxStepB)
        m.a = clamp(m.a + stepA, CFG.A_MIN, CFG.A_MAX)
        m.b = clamp(m.b + stepB, CFG.B_MIN, CFG.B_MAX)
    end

    function Learner:_onPerfect(m, now)
        m.pendErr, m.pendN = 0, 0
        m.holdRun = 0
        m.holdPrev = nil
        m.holdDownRun = (m.holdDownRun or 0) + 1
        if m.holdDownRun >= CFG.HOLD_DOWN_AFTER then
            m.hold = math.max(m.hold - CFG.HOLD_DOWN, CFG.HOLD_MIN)
            m.holdDownRun = 0
        end
    end

    function Learner:_onLate(m, ev, now)
        m.pendErr, m.pendN = 0, 0
        m.holdDownRun = 0
        local err = signedErr(ev)
        if not err then return end
        self:_fit(m, err, ev.dist or 0)
        if math.abs(err) <= CFG.HOLD_ERR_BAND then
            m.holdRun = (m.holdRun or 0) + 1
            if m.holdRun >= CFG.HOLD_UP_AFTER then
                m.holdPrev = m.hold
                m.hold = math.min(m.hold + CFG.HOLD_UP, CFG.HOLD_MAX)
                m.holdRun = 0
            end
        else
            m.holdRun = 0
        end
    end

    function Learner:_onEarly(m, ev, now)
        m.holdDownRun = 0
        local err = signedErr(ev)
        if err then
            m.pendErr += err
            m.pendN += 1
            if m.pendN >= CFG.EARLY_CONFIRM or math.abs(err) > CFG.EARLY_STRONG_MS then
                self:_fit(m, (m.pendErr / m.pendN) * CFG.EARLY_WEIGHT, ev.dist or 0)
                m.pendErr, m.pendN = 0, 0
            end
        end
        if m.holdPrev then
            m.hold = m.holdPrev
            m.holdPrev = nil
        end
    end

    function Learner:Predict(skillId, dist, baseSlope, seedA)
        local m = self:_model(skillId, baseSlope, seedA)
        local eff = math.max(0, (dist or 0) - CFG.B_OFFSET)
        local raw = m.a + m.b * eff
        return {
            delay = clamp(raw, CFG.DELAY_MIN, CFG.DELAY_MAX),
            hold = m.hold, key = m.id,
            confidence = math.min(m.n / CFG.MIN_SAMPLES, 1),
            samples = m.n, a = m.a, b = m.b,
        }
    end

    function Learner:OnRoundStart() self.inRound = true; self.spawnAt = clock() end
    function Learner:OnRoundEnd() self.inRound = false end
    function Learner:OnSpawn() self.spawnAt = clock() end
    function Learner:SetEnabled(v) self.enabled = v end

    function Learner:Stats()
        local rows = {}
        for _, m in pairs(self.models) do
            table.insert(rows, { key = m.id, a = round3(m.a), b = round3(m.b), hold = round3(m.hold), samples = m.n, stepScale = round3(m.scale) })
        end
        table.sort(rows, function(x, y) return x.samples > y.samples end)
        return { skips = table.clone(self.skips), models = rows }
    end

    function Learner:Reset()
        self.models = {}; self.skips = {}; self.lastEvent = {}; self.lagSamples = {}
        self.dirty = true; self:Save()
    end

    function Learner:_serialize()
        local body = { string.format("V%d|S=%d", 4, CFG.SCHEMA) }
        for _, m in pairs(self.models) do
            table.insert(body, string.format("%s|%.3f|%.4f|%.3f|%d|%.3f",
                m.id, m.a, m.b, m.hold, m.n, m.scale))
        end
        local s = table.concat(body, "\n")
        return string.format("CK=%d\n%s", checksum(s), s)
    end

    local function parse(text)
        local lines = {}
        for line in string.gmatch(text, "[\n]+") do table.insert(lines, line) end
        local head = table.remove(lines, 1)
        if not head then return nil end
        local ck = tonumber(string.match(head, "^CK=(%d+)"))
        local s = table.concat(lines, "\n")
        if not ck or ck ~= checksum(s) then return nil end
        local out = {}
        for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
            local id, a, b, h, n, sc = line:match("^(.-)|([|]+)|([|]+)|([|]+)|([|]+)|([|]+)$")
            if id and id ~= "" and tonumber(a) then
                out[id] = {
                    id = id,
                    a = clamp(tonumber(a) or 0, CFG.A_MIN, CFG.A_MAX),
                    b = clamp(tonumber(b) or CFG.BASE_SLOPE, CFG.B_MIN, CFG.B_MAX),
                    hold = clamp(tonumber(h) or CFG.HOLD_MIN, CFG.HOLD_MIN, CFG.HOLD_MAX),
                    n = tonumber(n) or 0,
                    scale = clamp(tonumber(sc) or 1, CFG.STEP_SCALE_MIN, 1),
                    dir = 0, sameRun = 0, holdPrev = nil,
                    holdRun = 0, holdDownRun = 0, pendErr = 0, pendN = 0, lastSeen = 0,
                }
            end
        end
        return out
    end

    function Learner:_load()
        if not (isfile and readfile) then return end
        for _, path in ipairs({ self.dbPath, self.bakPath }) do
            if isfile(path) then
                local ok, text = pcall(readfile, path)
                if ok and text then
                    local parsed = parse(text)
                    if parsed then self.models = parsed; return end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function Learner:Save()
        if not (writefile and isfile) then return end
        local payload = self:_serialize()
        if isfile(self.dbPath) then
            local ok, old = pcall(readfile, self.dbPath)
            if ok and old and writefile then pcall(writefile, self.bakPath, old) end
        end
        pcall(writefile, self.tmpPath, payload)
        local ok, check = pcall(readfile, self.tmpPath)
        if ok and check == payload then
            pcall(writefile, self.dbPath, payload)
            if delfile then pcall(delfile, self.tmpPath) end
            self.dirty = false
            self.lastSave = clock()
        end
    end
    return Learner
end)()

pcall(function()
    if isfolder and isfolder("KILLA Flex DB") and isfile and isfile("KILLA Flex DB/db.txt") then
        local ok, txt = pcall(readfile, "KILLA Flex DB/db.txt")
        if ok and txt and (txt:sub(1,4):find("V2") or txt:sub(1,4):find("V3")) then
            pcall(delfile, "KILLA Flex DB/db.txt")
            pcall(delfile, "KILLA Flex DB/db.txt.bak")
        end
    end
end)

local L = Learner.new()

-- CROWD DETECTION
local recentCasts = {}
local CAST_BLAME_WINDOW = 2.0
local function recordCast(casterName)
    local casterObj = Players:FindFirstChild(casterName) or Workspace:FindFirstChild(casterName)
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if casterObj and myChar then
        local cRoot = casterObj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if cRoot and myRoot then
            local dist = (cRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist <= 60 then table.insert(recentCasts, {caster = casterName, time = tick()}) end
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(recentCasts, {caster = casterName, time = tick()})
end
local function pruneCasts()
    local now = tick()
    for i = #recentCasts, 1, -1 do
        if now - recentCasts[i].time > CAST_BLAME_WINDOW then table.remove(recentCasts, i) end
    end
end
local function uniqueCasterCount()
    pruneCasts()
    local unique = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(recentCasts) do unique[entry.caster] = true end
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(unique) do count = count + 1 end
    return count
end
```
